Derek — apologies for the Sunday night message, but this can’t wait. The midterms are now officially **_less than 100 days away**_ , so the DNC is launching the 100-Day Fight Fund. Because to win anywhere, we have to organize everywhere. This is a longer message and in a minute, [**We're going to ask for your support. But first, let us explain why:](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-100daysout-2026?amount=7&refcode=em_20260726_8223_fr&refcode2=8223_22930333_XL_bor&akid=8223%2E22930333%2EXL_bor)** **[CHIP IN $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-100daysout-2026?amount=7?refcode=em_20260726_8223_fr&refcode2=8223_22930333_XL_bor&akid=8223%2E22930333%2EXL_bor)** We know times are tough right now, and the challenges we face with Trump attacking our democracy are real. This is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So here at the DNC, we have been working 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to show up for our communities and build a winning operation. We’ve got the results to show for it, too: Since Donald Trump took office, Democrats have won or outperformed in nearly **_90% of key elections**_. These victories weren't accidents. They happened because grassroots support allowed us to make historic, aggressive investments in organizing, voter registration, and state party infrastructure. Now, Derek, with less than 100 days left until Election Day, we’re doubling down. We are replacing a boom-and-bust campaign model with permanent political infrastructure. The bottom line is this: We’re not choosing between winning now OR building for the future. Our investments are designed to do _both_. **So, Derek, thank you for staying in this fight with us.** The fact that you’re reading this proves you haven’t given up on your country. You believe in the real promise of America, not the hollow lies coming from the White House. ** We’d be lying if we said this work was easy. It takes a lot of resources, and a lot of money. name: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez
subject: Trust in government won't be rebuilt through one giant piece of legislation
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
A while back, a daycare worker in Southwest Washington asked me a question I couldn't answer.
"Hey Congresslady, why can I legally open a bag of chips for these toddlers, but I can't peel a banana?"
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
She wasn't kidding.
I spent weeks chasing it down. What I heard back, over and over, was that she must be confused. Or exaggerating. Or that her boss was lying to her. Nobody extended her the basic credit of assuming she understood her own job.
And she was right.
Peeling a banana counts as food preparation. These providers get regulated as though they're making sushi, when all they're doing is opening a piece of fruit. And it isn't just Washington — it's everywhere rules got written without anyone asking the people actually caring for children what those rules would mean.
That's the real problem here. Not bananas. A lack of regard for the people doing the work.
I worked with Republicans and Democrats to pass what people have started calling the "banana bill." It directs the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary of Health and Human Services to create a low-risk classification for fresh fruits, vegetables, and other foods we eat raw.
And just a few weeks ago, it passed!
When our policies make a Cheeto easier to hand a toddler than an apple slice, something has gone wrong.
I'll keep chasing down the small fixes, because that's how trust in government gets rebuilt — one at a time, by paying attention to the things that make people's lives harder than they need to be.
Those little things matter, and I'll keep fighting to fix them.
If you'd like to help me keep bringing a little more common sense to Congress, I'd be grateful for any amount you can chip in to my re-election campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
Thank you for standing with me.
—Marie

Washougal, WA 98671

Meet my opponent, Scott Desjarlais.
He's "represented" Tennessee's 4th Congressional District since 2011. That's fourteen years of paychecks funded by your tax dollars and fourteen years of votes cast in Americans' names.
So here's the question: **what has he actually done for us?** Is your rent more affordable? Are groceries easier to manage? Is healthcare less of a financial nightmare? Do you feel like your kids have a real shot at a better life than you had?
Or... does it feel like no matter how hard you work, you just can't get ahead?
Every time working families in this district needed someone in their corner Scott DesJarlais was looking the other way. _**[Join the campaign looking to flip one of the most ineffective seats in Congress HERE, we've got under a month until primaries and need help!:](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/75e95a79-2c97-48d5-b44d-ec1d1b60388b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[CHIP IN HERE!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/75e95a79-2c97-48d5-b44d-ec1d1b60388b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
From January 2011 to April 2026, DesJarlais missed 440 out of 9,055 roll call votes, **a rate of 4.9%** , bringing him to more than double the median of missed votes among representatives right now. When he did bother to show up, he introduced the fewest bills of anyone in the entire Tennessee delegation, and in terms of bills he sponsored actually being signed into law? The number is effectively zero considering their effect.
### **Fourteen years. Zero laws to show for it.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6b5bbf08-3c8f-4457-a8aa-d53adb06c946?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

He shows up for the donors and lobbyists. He shows up when the cameras are on and the right people are watching, but when Americans under his wing are drowning?**Silence.**
I'm Mike Cortese. I'm a music industry veteran, a public servant, and a father who has lived through the kind of hardship that doesn't make it into press releases. I know what it means to fight for something real and I know that Tennessee's 4th District deserves a representative who actually fights for them.

Friends, JanePAC Organizing Team here. These days it’s hard to miss the headlines about record-breaking amounts of outside money pouring into races across the country. From hotly contested congressional seats to local utility boards, some of the fundraising totals are truly staggering. With so much cash flowing into our political system, it can seem like ordinary people can’t have an impact on the outcome of the races that impact them most. **The truth is __anyone can have an impact,__ without writing huge checks for candidates, just by showing up (in person or virtually) to volunteer their time.** **[That’s why we’re asking you to join our volunteer team today and help us keep up our momentum. If you’re already convinced, you can click here to sign up, or keep reading to learn more! ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136048283/636215025/-1641872660?refcode=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxODE0ZjdhLTVjODktZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=tOpiC-P0vD8-5stydCfIF3LkhJMgSSw10qgnO909jdM=&emci=db814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=4823105)** Over the last year, JanePAC volunteers have helped deliver real victories for candidates and communities across the country. **Our phonebankers made thousands of calls** to help flip the Salt River Project Board and secure primary victories for climate champions like Lauren Kuby in Arizona and Randy Villegas in California, proving that conversations between neighbors still win elections. **Our volunteer texters helped mobilize voters** in Brooke St. Claire’s City Council race and played a critical role in securing enough petition signatures to put the Michiganders for Money Out of Politics initiative on the ballot. **Our canvassers have knocked doors in critical races** in Colorado, helping elect leaders who are ready to stand up to polluters and fight the reckless expansion of data centers and other corporate polluters like Suncor. _Those victories didn’t happen by accident._ They happened because people decided to spend a few hours making calls, sending texts, knocking doors, and talking with voters about the issues that matter most to them. Now we need to grow our team. JanePAC is endorsing even more climate champions in races all across the country, and we’re looking for new volunteers to join this winning team to help call, knock, text, and more! **If you’ve ever wondered how you can make a real difference beyond donating,[_this is your chance._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136048284/636215026/-1641872660?refcode=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxODE0ZjdhLTVjODktZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=tOpiC-P0vD8-5stydCfIF3LkhJMgSSw10qgnO909jdM=&emci=db814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=4823105)** | [**JOIN THE TEAM**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136048285/636215027/-1641872660?refcode=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxODE0ZjdhLTVjODktZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=tOpiC-P0vD8-5stydCfIF3LkhJMgSSw10qgnO909jdM=&emci=db814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=4823105)

After you sign up, one of our organizers will personally reach out to learn about your interests, answer any questions, and help connect you with volunteer opportunities near you, or with one of our highest-priority campaigns if you’d like to volunteer from anywhere.
Whether you’re an experienced canvasser or have never volunteered before, we’ll help you find the right fit.
And because building community matters just as much as winning elections, we’re planning plenty of opportunities for volunteers to have fun along the way.
We hope you’ll consider joining us.
_See you on the team._
— The JanePAC Organizing Team

clean_body: 100 days until election day | Friends, JanePAC Organizing Team here. These days it’s hard to miss the headlines about record-breaking amounts of outside money pouring into races across the country. From hotly contested congressional seats to local utility boards, some of the fundraising totals are truly staggering. With so much cash flowing into our political system, it can seem like ordinary people can’t have an impact on the outcome of the races that impact them most. The truth is anyone can have an impact, without writing huge checks for candidates, just by showing up (in person or virtually) to volunteer their time. Over the last year, JanePAC volunteers have helped deliver real victories for candidates and communities across the country. Our phonebankers made thousands of calls to help flip the Salt River Project Board and secure primary victories for climate champions like Lauren Kuby in Arizona and Randy Villegas in California, proving that conversations between neighbors still win elections. Our volunteer texters helped mobilize voters in Brooke St. Claire’s City Council race and played a critical role in securing enough petition signatures to put the Michiganders for Money Out of Politics initiative on the ballot. Our canvassers have knocked doors in critical races in Colorado, helping elect leaders who are ready to stand up to polluters and fight the reckless expansion of data centers and other corporate polluters like Suncor. Those victories didn’t happen by accident. They happened because people decided to spend a few hours making calls, sending texts, knocking doors, and talking with voters about the issues that matter most to them. Now we need to grow our team. JanePAC is endorsing even more climate champions in races all across the country, and we’re looking for new volunteers to join this winning team to help call, knock, text, and more! If you’ve ever wondered how you can make a real difference beyond donating, | After you sign up, one of our organizers will personally reach out to learn about your interests, answer any questions, and help connect you with volunteer opportunities near you, or with one of our highest-priority campaigns if you’d like to volunteer from anywhere. Whether you’re an experienced canvasser or have never volunteered before, we’ll help you find the right fit. And because building community matters just as much as winning elections, we’re planning plenty of opportunities for volunteers to have fun along the way. We hope you’ll consider joining us. See you on the team. — The JanePAC Organizing Team | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Inside: stacks of cash from the 1970s. The full story is in today's _Et Cetera_. Have you ever opened a wall, cleaned out an attic, or sorted a garage and found something worth keeping? Today's poll asks, and we want the story behind your vote. Reply to this email to tell us. Have you factored these three flaws into your retirement math? Financial advisers have leaned on the same rule of thumb for decades, and the plan you've been counting on may be built around a number that quietly stops working just when you need it most. clean_body: A massive heat dome parked over the central U.S. this weekend, putting roughly 80 million people from Dallas to North Dakota, with dangerous temperatures expected to last through the week. | | | | | | Monday, July 27, 2026 ---|--- Good Morning! On this day in 1940, Bugs Bunny made his official debut in the cartoon short A Wild Hare , where he first asked, "What's up, Doc?" . A British couple spent months working up the nerve to open a they found behind a bricked-up wall in their cellar. Inside: stacks of cash from the 1970s. The full story is in today's Et Cetera. Have you ever opened a wall, cleaned out an attic, or sorted a garage and found something worth keeping? Today's poll asks, and we want the story behind your vote. Reply to this email to tell us. Have you factored these three flaws into your retirement math? Financial advisers have leaned on the same rule of thumb for decades, and the plan you've been counting on may be built around a number that quietly stops working just when you need it most. In today's episode of The Flyover Podcast , Ayla shares three flaws hiding in your retirement math and the fix that keeps the bills covered no matter what the market does. So how many of the three have you already planned for? Today's sponsor, , is offering a limited-time opportunity to invest in the company behind a leading VR productivity platform as it prepares for the launch of its next-generation Visor headset and a planned public listing. | 80 Million Swelter under Stalled Heat Dome A massive heat dome parked over the central U.S. this weekend, putting roughly 80 million people from Dallas to North Dakota, with dangerous temperatures expected to last through the week. "It looks like it is going to be pretty much stationary," a National Weather Service meteorologist said. Worse, overnight lows won't drop enough to offer , letting heat stress build day after day, and high humidity makes it all feel hotter. Forecasts called for 108 degrees in western Nebraska and near-record highs around 114 in Las Vegas, while even normally mild stretches of Montana and Wyoming are expected to top 100. The worst of the heat shifts toward Texas and the Gulf Coast by Wednesday. The Mid-Atlantic, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest should be spared. Surgeon General Targets Kids' Screen Time Early and excessive screen time can trigger in young children, harming attention, memory, and language skills, Interim Surgeon General Dr. Stephanie Haridopolos warned on Sunday. "Parents are now fighting for attention from the screens," she said. To fight back, her office released a framework called "the 5 Ds": discuss rules as a family, model good habits, divert kids to hands-on activities, disconnect during meals and car rides, and delay device access. One suggestion: charge phones overnight in the kitchen, not kids' bedrooms. The push builds on a linking excessive screen use to sleep disruption and mental health problems. BASE Jumpers Parachute off Space Needle Seattle police are searching for two men who of the city's iconic Space Needle Friday night and parachuted down from the 605-foot landmark. The pair bought tickets, rode up to the observation deck, then ducked into a restroom and emerged wearing helmets before hopping the glass and leaping off. Videos of the jump quickly spread online. . Security guards lost track of where the men landed, and responding officers came up empty. Peter,
Last week, while the country's attention was fixed on Trump's primetime address on elections, senior White House official Stephen Miller delivered a speech that should send shivers down the spine of every American.
At a gathering branded the "Resurgence of Political Terrorism," Miller said Democrats are a "cancer" that must be "rooted out" before it can "destroy society." He painted a picture of the "perfect family that goes to church every Sunday" under siege, and he claimed that our courts and legal systems have grown too "soft" to deal with the threat:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yuX_3tAL5iJnnCmgA4xUHWhPKhamuTqvq_Rt0q14TU-HB9h2Prj7eNx59alL8SBI1ma7BRo1mqH_gZYpTC8zqd2NalA0FKJxWkCrhwewR7GPge-wjndU7_U00dpeu_nJJ25P2TO97axXUzcUjU6bwLdC9Btil5TdPH_ISKK4YIxLRSGFXjuLV8XrmMMabP4dpklZOajsTELOAUXS0pXSdKJ2Nx7GCPU1xI4Mvzc_jcPQBv67SL090w==&c=3TvIFDdsHewj4ibFCoDin4j1loIe7EIigDl_41JQ58VcSyyohxoYIA==&ch=IaIDuRVzFkH4iBKch_nrHJ9xtyEuPH77bM9Db-I-qduvCloCs_VM4A==)
---
It's no hyperbole--this was a speech lifted straight from Goebbels and Hitler. He described being a Democrat as a literal disease that causes physical deformity. But Miller didn't stop at words. He also vowed to use NSPM-7, the administration's national security memorandum, to "disrupt, defund, debank, arrest, and prosecute" Democrats.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yuX_3tAL5iJnnCmgA4xUHWhPKhamuTqvq_Rt0q14TU-HB9h2Prj7eNx59alL8SBI1ma7BRo1mqH_gZYpTC8zqd2NalA0FKJxWkCrhwewR7GPge-wjndU7_U00dpeu_nJJ25P2TO97axXUzcUjU6bwLdC9Btil5TdPH_ISKK4YIxLRSGFXjuLV8XrmMMabP4dpklZOajsTELOAUXS0pXSdKJ2Nx7GCPU1WwHrJnpJpCNWRh0zbuXtqQ==&c=3TvIFDdsHewj4ibFCoDin4j1loIe7EIigDl_41JQ58VcSyyohxoYIA==&ch=IaIDuRVzFkH4iBKch_nrHJ9xtyEuPH77bM9Db-I-qduvCloCs_VM4A==)
---
Trump's election speech laid out the manufactured pretext for contesting the midterm election results. NSPM-7 and Miller's rhetoric are the machinery to criminalize the opposition and rig the election. And it's already in motion. Just weeks ago the FBI raided the liberal voting rights organization the Ohio Organizing Collaborative. America Votes is also under investigation. The persecution of Democratic organizations has already begun.
We need to make this election too big to rig. That means every Democrat in the streets--protesting, rallying, registering freedom-loving Americans to vote, and getting them to the polls. And it means courts strong enough to hold the line against Trump's fascist takeover of our elections.
That's why what Defend Our Courts is doing matters so much at this moment. We're fighting to expand and protect the Democratic firewall of state Supreme Courts, the only bodies that can stop these efforts, on a national scale this November. But to operate at the scale this moment demands, we need your help -- right now.

body:
Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-kqs1grv7ud-12934973?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| | | | |
---
| |
### NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN
---
| | Friends and Neighbors,
We’ve been busy, and I’m glad you’re reading this quick update from me. I will always be a better Representative when we’re sharing information and when I’m receiving feedback from my constituents. As you read on, please remember to let me know if you have any questions or ideas.
It’s worth reminding you that our very important **Primary Election** is coming up on **August 18**. I hope to see you while I’m out campaigning throughout the district. If you would like to get involved in the campaign or put a sign in your yard, we would love to hear from you. Whatever you do, don’t forget to vote! It’s a sacred privilege and responsibility, and we should all participate.
As always, please do not hesitate to [**contact my office**](https://us.list-manage.com/VBf6MqhtSWM?e=d1c1b9864f&c2id=d3808649044f505f0f4143aac3cd50ac&m=ambjs2o5mo7EBR3t6S9blQ3S_qbTl8d11gooKdNY-bAGg78m3npM2cUbI4o=) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| |
### Abraham Lincoln in The Villages
---
|
---
|
---
| | It was a privilege to spend time with **Governor Ron DeSantis** and attend his press conference in **The Villages** to unveil an America 250 statue of **Abraham Lincoln**.
While other states are tearing down statues, we are putting them up! It’s a sad situation that so many of our heroes from history have been deemed unacceptable by the liberals that dominate higher education and the mainstream media. I’m proud of our Governor for taking a stand on these kinds of issues and what better place than The Villages to remind people that history and traditional values are not dead in Florida.

---
| |
### Let Freedom Ring Event
---
|
---
|
---
| | I spoke at the **Let Freedom Ring Event** put on by **The Ocala Church** to celebrate America's 250th birthday. What a wonderful time to reflect on our history as a nation, which was founded by people who knew we should live in freedom, especially freedom to worship. Our faith is foundational to everything good about America and I’m so grateful we can continue to build on the legacy our Founders gave us.

---
| |
### Hands of Mercy Everywhere (H.O.M.E.)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/c24auwiW_T6?e=d1c1b9864f&c2id=d3808649044f505f0f4143aac3cd50ac&m=lF8l6vdyKC_9aHM9urUqHxTwFqYSspVuRtysQpmR6KiIrx3GfVsimOIXhG4=)
| | I joined **Senator Stan McClain** in presenting a check to **Hands of Mercy Everywhere** (H.O.M.E.), a wonderful organization which provides Christian residential homes for teen mothers and their babies and girls at risk of sex trafficking. So much work goes into providing support to this at-risk population. Organizations like **H.O.M.E.** deserve our gratitude and praise.
This past session, we were able to secure significant state funding for H.O.M.E.’s **Teen Moms and At-Risk Youth Prep Vocational Training Program**.

---
| |
### Bob Rose Show
---
|
---
| | I made an appearance on the **Bob Rose Show** and gave him my thoughts on two hot topics, data centers and property taxes. Bob always asks great questions and gives me an opportunity to get my message out. We live in exciting times with a lot of technological advancements, but we can’t ignore the potential costs to our land, water, and communities. And we definitely would be better off without property taxes!

---
| |
### Freedom Leadership Conference
---
|
---
| | I had the opportunity to open for the **Freedom Leadership Conference** at the **College Central Florida**. My hat is off to CCF and the great work they’re doing for our community, providing high quality education and keeping costs reasonable for the people of Marion County and our surrounding area. I was happy to share the vision of America’s freedom for the last 250 years and to talk about what it takes to keep us free.
I also had the opportunity to speak to **America's Tea Party of Florida** about my work to end property taxes and to answer their questions about the upcoming ballot initiative. So much has transpired since the Tea Party arose and led to a conservative sweep of elections in 2010. We have to continue working hard for fiscal discipline and to stop government from taxing and spending too much.

---
| |
### American Legislative Exchange Council
---
|
---
|
---
| | The **American Legislative Exchange Council** (ALEC) is a great organization that provides resources for legislators all across the country who want to share ideas about public policy and work together to advance good legislation. I was pleased to attend ALEC’s **Annual Meeting** , where we heard from **Dr. Mehmet Oz** and a host of great speakers. I’ll definitely benefit from this time as I get ready for the next legislative session.
---
|
---
| |
### Endorsements
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | I proud to report I’ve been endorsed by **Chief Financial Office Blaise Ingoglia** and **Attorney General James Uthmeier**. Both men have been instrumental in establishing a safer and more secure Florida, where freedom is our first priority and the entire country looks to us for leadership. This transformation of our state would not be possible without the hard work and dedication of these conservative officials.
I’m also proud to have been endorsed by **Associated Industries of Florida** , the “Voice of Florida Business” in the Sunshine State. AIF pursues a simple agenda: to defend the free market, to create jobs, and to keep Florida prospering.
---
|
---
| |
### Ending Property Taxes
---
| | One final word to remind you of my top priority, **to end property taxes in the State of Florida**! To stay up to date with my work on this issue, please [follow me on Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/8dukMAKI5dz?e=d1c1b9864f&c2id=d3808649044f505f0f4143aac3cd50ac&m=xf3pFUltY98yW15haxdmnOx7aDPXD-9TnzoeJTxlINNh44HLrzaueXuwCJw=). As always, if you have any questions, don’t hesitate to contact my office.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.
Best regards,
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **Ryan Chamberlin****State Representative****District 24**

Whatever you do, don’t forget to vote! It’s a sacred privilege and responsibility, and we should all participate. As always, please do not hesitate to = if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can. | | Abraham Lincoln in The Villages | | | | It was a privilege to spend time with Governor Ron DeSantis and attend his press conference in The Villages to unveil an America 250 statue of Abraham Lincoln. While other states are tearing down statues, we are putting them up! It’s a sad situation that so many of our heroes from history have been deemed unacceptable by the liberals that dominate higher education and the mainstream media. I’m proud of our Governor for taking a stand on these kinds of issues and what better place than The Villages to remind people that history and traditional values are not dead in Florida. | | Let Freedom Ring Event | | | | I spoke at the Let Freedom Ring Event put on by The Ocala Church to celebrate America's 250th birthday. What a wonderful time to reflect on our history as a nation, which was founded by people who knew we should live in freedom, especially freedom to worship. Our faith is foundational to everything good about America and I’m so grateful we can continue to build on the legacy our Founders gave us. | | Hands of Mercy Everywhere (H.O.M.E.) = | | I joined Senator Stan McClain in presenting a check to Hands of Mercy Everywhere (H.O.M.E.), a wonderful organization which provides Christian residential homes for teen mothers and their babies and girls at risk of sex trafficking. So much work goes into providing support to this at-risk population. Organizations like H.O.M.E. deserve our gratitude and praise. This past session, we were able to secure significant state funding for H.O.M.E.’s Teen Moms and At-Risk Youth Prep Vocational Training Program. | | Bob Rose Show | | | I made an appearance on the Bob Rose Show and gave him my thoughts on two hot topics, data centers and property taxes. Bob always asks great questions and gives me an opportunity to get my message out. We live in exciting times with a lot of technological advancements, but we can’t ignore the potential costs to our land, water, and communities. And we definitely would be better off without property taxes! | | Freedom Leadership Conference | | | I had the opportunity to open for the Freedom Leadership Conference at the College Central Florida. My hat is off to CCF and the great work they’re doing for our community, providing high quality education and keeping costs reasonable for the people of Marion County and our surrounding area. I was happy to share the vision of America’s freedom for the last 250 years and to talk about what it takes to keep us free. I also had the opportunity to speak to America's Tea Party of Florida about my work to end property taxes and to answer their questions about the upcoming ballot initiative. So much has transpired since the Tea Party arose and led to a conservative sweep of elections in 2010. We have to continue working hard for fiscal discipline and to stop government from taxing and spending too much. | | American Legislative Exchange Council | | | | The American Legislative Exchange Council (ALEC) is a great organization that provides resources for legislators all across the country who want to share ideas about public policy and work together to advance good legislation. I was pleased to attend ALEC’s Annual Meeting , where we heard from Dr. Mehmet Oz and a host of great speakers. I’ll definitely benefit from this time as I get ready for the next legislative session. | | | Endorsements | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I proud to report I’ve been endorsed by Chief Financial Office Blaise Ingoglia and Attorney General James Uthmeier. Both men have been instrumental in establishing a safer and more secure Florida, where freedom is our first priority and the entire country looks to us for leadership. This transformation of our state would not be possible without the hard work and dedication of these conservative officials. I’m also proud to have been endorsed by Associated Industries of Florida , the “Voice of Florida Business” in the Sunshine State. AIF pursues a simple agenda: to defend the free market, to create jobs, and to keep Florida prospering. | | | Ending Property Taxes | | One final word to remind you of my top priority, to end property taxes in the State of Florida! To stay up to date with my work on this issue, please =. As always, if you have any questions, don’t hesitate to contact my office. | | | | Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon. Best regards, | | | | | | | | | | | | | Ryan ChamberlinState RepresentativeDistrict 24 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | = = = | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2026 Ryan Chamberlin for State Representative. ## Paxton, Talarico Agree on AI Guardrails
Both major candidates for a U.S. Senate seat from Texas [called for guardrails](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOiNjDIbCxTV0_7VXogUvySqLHdmbkLz9KXmFv5pi9I1G37-f5QeIKV7-woFeXntaIp6FUQTzInDCLUViuGHGsj3wSBkP4sVoMyjtlHFLAOL3YuvgVx2mtkbfurFve912rr76EawZ3TT1U7dqN3XGTasFHXDczDiYoSb_GdPOuLbVprWN7cO0bjtYPe4OOqysxkCSciNXFHxB2fmdnpibLR01-6vIvVTdn8rMlZnP82xuL4ifsjJzERBUaVdfsDLzN9U9MQltBLGoDZjVnrK6PCCHDMRFpaiAVAABtWEUzB-0zj7cT2KmMrjK6ssBxN8T8jt1T2_-BwAA__9Fm4TO) on artificial intelligence this week, after OpenAI said one of its models [escaped a test environment](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOwyAUBNDT4A4Lf7BJCopt3GXbLa0PfNsoYCJM4uT2K-8VthtppDfS_NymG4YYtuUbE5n6nvO00bFHqpXKVPHAe95CxDsV2t2TUi6UQpxAwMCF5qAnjyF-JtV4Y4W_dg2ZTl_6rhed1M1qZrpY18t-sDgIJ50V-qpJovTgiIRqgjkxoUF3nYBOtar3V-tmVOIya5TElCAfai5tXanSG_c5fvKLSutyaqJZa33sTH4xGBmMx3G0brPuLBmMp81gFPrMwGDMD9o4Bu4-lgpP2VPc-YruztfnsoRt4TM6ateaYlOMfxwhxrAPmimxJAzxb7T-76qXgd8AAAD__9UcfXA) and hacked the AI platform Hugging Face during a security evaluation. Democrat candidate James Talarico said Wednesday the state must "strike a balance between being a leader in technology and innovation as our state has always been and protecting working people from the harms of these data centers." Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton said Texas must "compete against China" but ensure "people are protected from the downsides." The debate follows Gov. Greg Abbott's directive to [regulators to shield ratepayers](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2upDAQhE8DmZFtfswLHGxC9jbdEDV2A9YzNmo3zMztVzN7hI2r9Knq-_M9f0OIIW2_4UDLzzXPCR8lIjPSzPCAn5xChB8kLO7CIxMeIc5a6kFII7SZPYT4mrva20X6L1WjVWbsVS9Va-rdDoMxsjfSd6OX7dgq55UcFUi9DN6Nsg72DZNGG6WkVl3T9f5rcSt0clwNtFh1En3gTA3vyPiEssZXvpEal4862p35LFX7q9JTpact382n1Gz5rvT0vlPp6cyF_6VIKZOAZcnMwgdCx0WclxOQvEBymQVnUfaA0Ys3KRWxUj6EBwbhMDGSCGklKEyX44tQuFy41GT9-QgxhjKYqpPbASF-NvL_mb2t_hsAAP__q3SRgg) from data center costs and his call to [ban new centers in rural neighborhoods](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOiPbmBgKF9fQ_ddeidb2OrGy4MhsQvL2J_IKfzfFaD7N9-9n-YFMebv-hRUdv1NZNjx2QmasC8MB97JlgjtW3MMT11JxzbRoqS9CWqHtEiHTZzFtdF7GSbXolB0HNUjV2_bmdAojTmNSZpjGfpyS95O1qFHpcLH90GZ3jkmrrVJSK9OZIU4-JDByTBZ6bIzEmLnUjm_I-IY90ae8sHahrC25G_Njb_o_jZ4bPR_H0aXyNueNs9Do-YyNnsH7wiwCEO3CwyYiMIiAG2MVEV9I5bHixqI-K5D4ktrq4uPIRHm_2MbI6wqZvlz-na2X0_8DAAD__2pMgS4). Gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa (D) urged Abbott to issue an emergency executive order declaring a moratorium.
## Houston Marchers Demand ICE Answers
Mourners carrying rows of yellow construction hats walked through Houston's Magnolia Park on Sunday for [Lorenzo Salgado Araujo](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2unDAQxfGnMZ1XtvkwFC7S0N20KdGAB5is8axss1zy9NHmFVL_pKOj_6-v6QsoUNx-woGufK88RbxywFIwTQUueHKkAE9MmJcTD054UJiMMp1UVho7eaBwT03l3az8oCt02vatbpWubbU7ZXAeoJtbgLVDxGHue21XgHZeu6GuK3KfMWWN1VoZ3Tya1g_zskKj-tVCjaJR6KlwepQdC35DXsPNb0yPhY8quL2UVxb1D2FGYUaYF11_RJjxxbkIMy58HGekcsudg8_ylXjBnImjfNNGQQZOGP-wzBA28CwhwfmbZUZ8UtwkxHxhytIj-HBLWlDmnbl8bOczF47CjHpo7WBNL8xYJedfF4VAubOiUdsBFP69Lf_X-O3M3wAAAP__wDyUxw), the construction worker shot and killed by an ICE agent on July 7. A day earlier, advocacy groups, faith leaders, and elected officials [rallied downtown](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAURp9GOwxcEbSg-Bu7-dstzRUuSgZlgsw48_YbN_sG2598X875uk03DDHsy3_cyJS3T9NO5xGpFMpTwRPvaQ8R75TpsE_aUqYtxAk4KMY1Az05DPEzydqZmbtB1GSE7jvRcdHqejXQWTWQku0MSg9D33vtwXmtete6Wfk6mGuMa9BCcBCykZ0bZutR8t5rbKmSnFwoKTdlpUJvPHz8pBflxqatjmYt5XFU7b8KxgrG8zwbn96g1vQ8StovqILxsqpgXHJ6PtiCZaXMfgmWMcYP2zDblVmMVw5Gu2PBUp2Ne5whxnAoXUm-bBjiz2_5W62Xge8AAAD__6AhgU4) and marched to City Hall. The Department of Homeland Security says Salgado Araujo, 52, was in the country illegally, rammed an ICE vehicle, ignored commands, and tried to run over an officer, who [fired in self-defense](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGymzAQRb9GdPJIi7CgoEhD99KmZPSkxWy8II-0Ns_5-gyZ_MHr79xz7_n1MX8EYtpvP8OGo3wted7xqIwiWGYJR7jnnTjcsWCNT9xywY14BgNXbbwGP6dA_J5dk8ZPkwbb4Gh939nO2NY36zgs3rap7xxATJ11S-ii63scIgzX1vUNjWeZ8eCtNWDdxXVp-IxLcKZffGhROYOJJJeLrCj4FerC7_zCcol5a3hcRR5VtT8UTAqm4zgukSneYc3PKnk_Uwqm85aCiXMMrGA6mQom4xVMtlUw_X5WoYh6yUVzLrj_yTqGPTEy3VbRL7oR61TCUfVpQcsadm2N0Q_MD0YtWf8n6kjy1mvgE9SUMT0OYqZ69cqZ2xaI_y2X7_l-jfA3AAD__1hflbc). The agency has acknowledged he was not the man agents wanted. His family and the men riding with him dispute that account. The family says the father of three had no criminal record, had lived in the United States for nearly 35 years, and was seeking legal status. The FBI, DHS, the Texas Rangers, and the [Harris County district attorney](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGy2yAQRb8GdXgQksxzoSIN3UubUrOGRdp4xb4BZD3n6zPOL6S_c-8959fn8gnElNefsOPcvpMsGc_K2BqWpcEJD8nE8MCCNRy4S8GdeLHGXrVx2rolAvFrGbs430289R3OvfuY-sn0g-u2GSJeb3BzYMJ9vE526EczTVNEkwwOKXU0v8uMs67vje3HyzjF2z0kGM1HcjCgGg1GalIubcOG31ATv-SJ5RJk73jeWvuqavihrFfWn-d5CUzhYTc5apP8Tinr31jKepYArKx_byrrjVPW94OyfoNSqOogR24vHUE_5aw6Hcya8hNroxUaSdaUm-gEDVhTQF03kUZ51ZI0S8H8R3QFXiGKhgLHb1HWd2WOXycxU706NZp1B-J_99v_SX_O9m8AAAD__5y5mSY) are each investigating. Federal officials say no body or dash camera video exists.
## Game Wardens Rescue Tawakoni Boater
A fisherman thrown from his boat spent more than three hours in Lake Tawakoni before Texas game wardens [spotted him through binoculars](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQhU8DnZFtDIbCxTZ02XZLNOBxsGLjyJ6EcPsVG-0J_m6keXp63_fnNt_AB7_ff0NEQx-X5h2PEpAI80xwwCPtPsADM5b1hTFljD7Mksuecc2kni34cM6qtmbhdhQ1GqGHTnRctLrezNJp3TuUo5J2GfpuGHpl23bsOueEsrL25irjWmohuBSqUZ0dl9WB4oPT0GKlOFpPKTe0IeEHigtnemNu1hTrYDaiZ6naX5WcKjkdx9G49FEXxhWo5HSdlZycLxvmCDujLadjZy6nyJYExL5wlhVwGM7v44Jm_w0wcISZxVcgz-CO-3qygpDXrc7GPg8fgi-9rhS_R_Dh3zL6mc-3kX8DAAD__5O5jhM) on Saturday morning. Rains County wardens got the call shortly before 7:15 a.m. that a boater competing in a local fishing tournament had gone missing. His boat had struck a stump in the water. Two volunteer fire departments, three drone teams, and two air medical crews [joined the search](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAQhp8Gd1gDsYNdUFzjLtdeaQ1mSLhgE-HZkLz9yrvaJ9juk0b6Rt__7zJfMKa4Xf_iSpZfIc8b1T0RM5WZseI9bzHhnQrtywetudAa06xBnyUYqc3sMab33DXeOvCjasgqM_SqB3Uyzc3C6JUfjQLdkQuDGwCxR3DBgTMqLE20hwyMNkqBVl3b9X50S8AOhmDwRKID8pFzaflGTC_cQ3rnJ5V2yWuT7I35sYvTH6Enoadaa3tP_DyOQk-HW-gJzMEH8aN6ueImv4O8POLkT6nEwFQk_aeFY96ky8hCT02x_lFjSnE_G9HBdcWYvt7z70Z7Wv0ZAAD__-s6gUA), which stretched across the morning. The man was wearing a life jacket and had the boat's engine cutoff switch attached, which officials credited with saving his life. "_Always wear a life jacket and use your engine cutoff switch_ ," the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department wrote. "_They only work if you use them._ "

Occasionally something happens that gives me a bad feeling in the pit of my stomach. It happened this past Friday when the DNC announced that South Carolina would be the first primary state in the 2028 Democratic primary. The DNC committee voted 26 for South Carolina, 19 for Nevada, and 4 for New Hampshire.
"Okay, so what?" you ask.
Let's go back to the 2020 primary - Joe Biden's campaign is on life support in February after weak results in Iowa, New Hampshire and Nevada. Bernie is on the march. Then, Congressman Jim Clyburn of South Carolina endorses Joe Biden. Joe Biden surges and gets 49% of the vote, beating Bernie's 2nd place finish by 30 points. Pete Buttigieg and Amy Klobuchar drop out and get behind Biden, who then wins Super Tuesday and becomes President.
It's no exaggeration to say that Jim Clyburn was the reason that Joe Biden became President in 2020. His reward was twofold: first, Clyburn pushed Joe Biden to name Kamala Harris as his running mate. Second, South Carolina was moved up to be the first primary state in 2024. This served as a giant red 'Stop' sign telling candidates not to run against Joe Biden in 2024 - I was in South Carolina with Dean Phillips when Dean flouted the establishment by running against Joe.
After Biden's disastrous debate and decision to step aside, Jim Clyburn also pushed Joe Biden to anoint Kamala Harris in 2024 without a competitive primary. That didn't go well.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/018a89b5-9002-4d20-a05b-9c4e56f6b0d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What will Jim Clyburn's agenda be in 2028? Well, this might be unwelcome news, but Kamala Harris is telling people in California that she is running for President again. She showed up to a political event last weekend that was a pretty clear step in that direction. And with South Carolina awaiting her as the first state, her campaign just got an enormous leg up. Jim Clyburn will almost certainly put his thumb on the scale and, due to his enormous influence in South Carolina, ensure that his chosen candidate wins.
I spent a lot of time in South Carolina. I really like the people in the state. But South Carolina isn't a swing state, and its voters are disproportionately swayed by what Jim Clyburn tells them to do. He probably moved Joe Biden from 15% to 49% in 2020.
If you were rational, you would have all of your primaries take place in swing states because 1. You would have a lot of time, energy and money spent in those states which could pull voters your way in the general election and 2. You kind of want voters who represent the general electorate. New Hampshire, Nevada, and Michigan are all swing states. So are Georgia and North Carolina if you wanted a southern state.
As you might be able to tell, I think this whole thing is a disaster. I ran alongside Kamala Harris in 2020 - that campaign did not go well for her. She dropped out before the voting started. And in 2024, I thought her poor performance in interviews made her team gunshy about having her do interviews, which is kind of a crucial thing in a presidential campaign.
That said, she has universal name ID and a humungous list as well as some loyalists like Jim Clyburn who will help shrink the field. And what else is she going to do? It's either run again and stay relevant or recede into quasi-retirement. Her path just got a lot easier.
Jim Clyburn is 86 years old. His endorsement shaped the 2020 primaries. Will it shape the 2028 field as well? I sure hope not, but I fear it will. The DNC just handed him the first big lever that will embolden the wrong candidate to run. The Democratic Party doesn't learn from its mistakes; it closes ranks and repeats them.
I hope your summer is going great! name: Melanie Lucero For Congress
subject: 8 days out. One story before you vote.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY MELANIE LUCERO FOR CONGRESS
body:
I never gave abortion much thought — until I learned about the choice that gave me my husband.
| [ MELANIE LUCERO
FOR CONGRESS · VIRGINIA'S 5TH DISTRICT ](https://us.list-manage.com/fRSDZTy8stI?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---
Where I stand · Life
# The choice that gave me my husband.
Peter,I'll be honest with you about something. All my life I've been responsible in my relationships, and so locked onto the mission in front of me that I never gave abortion much thought. It was something other people argued about on television.Then one day I sat down with my husband's mother, and she told me her story.When she found out she was pregnant, the father — a man who came from wealth — put money on the table for an abortion. And if she refused? She'd be raising the baby alone. No support. No help. A young woman, standing at that crossroads with nothing but her faith.She was a Christian. She believed life was a gift from God. She said no — knowing exactly what it would cost her.Because she said no, the world got one more police officer protecting the streets. One more man protecting this country from terrorists. One more mentor teaching young people to stand up and defend themselves, their families, and their country.**Because she said no, I have my husband.** And the ripple didn't stop with him. The world also got his son — my stepson — who joined the United States Navy and has served his country honorably. One young woman's choice, two generations of service to America. And counting.And those are only the blessings we can see. What about the ones we'll never know? Somewhere out there may be someone who's alive because my husband answered a call in time. A young person who chose a better path because a mentor finally believed in them. A shipmate who made it home because my stepson did his job well. When a life is allowed to happen, the good it does multiplies in ways no one can ever count.Now turn that question around — because if she had taken the money, all of it disappears. The streets lose a police officer. This country loses a man who stood between us and terrorists. A generation of young people loses the mentor who taught them to fight for their families and their country. The Navy loses a sailor. And every life they've touched, saved, or shaped — gone with them. That's the true cost of "the easier choice," and it never shows up on anyone's receipt. How many police officers has the world been denied? How many protectors, nurses, Marines, sailors, teachers, mothers and fathers? How many miracles have been erased in the name of convenience?That's why I don't waver. I believe life begins at conception, and that every unborn baby is worthy of protection. Full stop.In Congress, I'll vote to end federal funding of abortion, defund Planned Parenthood, and pass the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act — because a child who survives birth deserves a doctor, not a debate.My husband's mother held the line alone, with everything and everyone against her. The least I can do is hold it in Congress. | [Read Where I Stand On Life](https://us.list-manage.com/2TbatGQJtzb?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---
Takes two minutes. No forms, no pop-ups — just where I stand.
* * *
For the 5th,
Melanie Lucero
Marine Veteran · Republican for Congress, VA-05

Five years ago today, I walked into a hearing room in the United States Capitol and testified under oath about what happened to me and my colleagues on January 6th.
I told them about the mob. The violence. The racial slurs screamed at me while I was in uniform, trying to protect the peaceful transfer of power. I told the truth. I have never stopped telling it.
That testimony led me to run for Congress. After I left the Capitol Police, I decided the only way to keep fighting for accountability was to go back to that building, this time as a member. I ran for an open seat in Maryland. I gave everything I had to that race. Outside special interests spent $11 million to silence me. I came in third. I am not going to pretend that it doesn't sting.
But here is what I need you to understand: I am not depressed about losing a race. I am angry about the state of this country. Those are two very different things.
The fight for democracy never depended on any one election. I wrote a book called Standing My Ground. That was about what I did on January 6th, one officer, one day, one story. This newsletter is called Standing Our Ground because the work ahead of us belongs to all of us. I cannot do this without you and I am not going to try.
I will not gaslight you. I do not know if everything is going to be okay. What I do know is that if we keep showing up, if we keep fighting back, we give ourselves a chance. That is enough for me. I hope it is enough for you too.
Here is what Standing Our Ground will look like:
**Free, always:**
* The Watch: A short daily video. My honest take on the most important story of the day.
* The Daily Dispatch: Monday through Friday. What is happening and why it matters.
* The Good Trouble Report: Every Wednesday. One person who stood up that week when it cost them something.
* The 6th: On the 6th of every month. One story keeping January 6th accountability alive.

**Paid members ($8/mo or $80/yr):**
* Off Duty: Every Friday. Personal, off the clock. The version of me without a microphone in my face.
* OnlyDems: Conversations with Democrats actually doing the work. Not the cable regulars.
* Roll Call: Monthly live AMA. You ask, I answer. No prepared remarks.

_**On January 6th I stood in that building and held the line. Five years later I am still standing. So are you. That matters more than I can say.**_
Standing Our Ground together.

name: Power the Polls
subject: August 11 is National Poll Worker Recruitment Day – here's why it matters
body:
| The EAC set this date to get more people like you to step up. _You’re getting this message from[ _Power the Polls_](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4508?t=1&akid=9081%2E934366%2E4TFd8-) because you signed up to learn about serving as a poll worker. If you no longer wish to hear from us, [_please unsubscribe here_](https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=9081.934366.4TFd8-&t=2&akid=9081%2E934366%2E4TFd8-). Marking emails as spam can affect our ability to reach others with important information. _
# [](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/42?t=3&akid=9081%2E934366%2E4TFd8-)
Hey Peter— Mark your calendar: August 11 is National Poll Worker Recruitment Day. The U.S. Election Assistance Commission – the bipartisan commission dedicated to supporting election administrators – set aside this date to rally more people like you to step up and serve. Organizations will be going all out to recruit as many people as possible to get their applications in for elections in November, and at Power the Polls,[**we want to recruit 10,000 today.**](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4923?t=4&akid=9081%2E934366%2E4TFd8-) Local election offices need poll workers now, and getting your application in early means you beat the rush. **Help us hit that goal and beat the crowd:** [Complete My Application](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4923?t=5&akid=9081%2E934366%2E4TFd8-) One more thing: if you've already started your application, we'd love to know where things stand. Since it goes straight to your local elections office, we don't always know if you've finished, started training, or decided the timing isn't right. **[Take two minutes to update us on your application status](https://act.powerthepolls.org/survey/2024_poll_worker_experience_survey_step_1/?t=6&akid=9081%2E934366%2E4TFd8-)** so we can send you the most useful next steps. Every application matters. Let's get ahead of August 11 together. —The Power the Polls Team *Poll workers might be called something different in your area – like "election workers" or "election judges" – but no matter the name, folks are needed to keep elections running smoothly!
---
* * *
This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). You received this message because you are subscribed to Power the Polls' mailing list. [Click here to unsubscribe.](https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?ak_proof=1&akid=9081.934366.4TFd8-&t=7&akid=9081%2E934366%2E4TFd8-) If you have any questions, please contact us at [info@powerthepolls.org](mailto:info@powerthepolls.org) and a member of our team will be in touch.

Lead Story · Foreign PolicyNETANYAHU ARRIVES AT THE WHITE HOUSE AS TRUMP WEIGHS IRAN'S NEXT MOVEWhat's Happening
* Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu departed for Washington on Monday to meet President Trump at the White House, with the Iran conflict and Gaza topping the agenda.
* U.S. offensive strikes on Iran have been **paused for three consecutive nights** as Trump weighs diplomacy against a return to major military action.
* Netanyahu will also attend the funeral service for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., whom he called a "dear friend."

The Situation
* The visit follows last month's 12-day conflict, in which the U.S. and Israel struck Iranian nuclear sites; a fragile pause has held between rounds of fighting.
* Tehran has publicly rejected broader nuclear negotiations and _claims_ it still controls the Strait of Hormuz, saying it turned back several ships — assertions that have not been independently verified.
* Netanyahu says U.S. and Israeli intelligence are coordinating closely and that he expects to hear Trump's plans directly during the meeting, which could shape whether Israel resumes strikes.

The PerspectivePausing the bombs to test whether Tehran is serious is a defensible use of leverage — provided the pause is a tactic and not a retreat. Peace through strength only works if the strength stays credible. If Iran reads three quiet nights as permission to stall, rebuild, and posture over Hormuz, the pause will have bought Tehran time rather than bought America a deal. TradeTRUMP HITS 60 COUNTRIES WITH NEW TARIFFS AFTER SUPREME COURT SETBACKWhat's Happening
* The administration rolled out new **Section 301 tariffs on 60 countries** , which took effect Friday, July 24 at 12:01 a.m. ET.
* Rates are split in two: **12.5%** for countries with no forced-labor import laws and **10%** for those deemed to enforce such laws insufficiently.
* The move replaces a temporary 10% global tariff that expired Friday — itself a stopgap after the Supreme Court struck down Trump's "Liberation Day" tariffs in February.

The Situation
* The new rates do not stack with existing duties — steel and aluminum, for example, stay at 50% rather than climbing higher.
* Exemptions cover fertilizers, some fuels, certain foods, autos, metals and pharmaceuticals, and officials say bilateral carve-outs are being negotiated.
* China, the EU, Canada and the U.K. rejected the forced-labor rationale, and critics argue the tariffs are a workaround of the Supreme Court's ruling — a framing one administration official called "simplistic."

The PerspectiveGrounding the tariffs in forced-labor enforcement is a smarter legal footing than the emergency-powers theory the Court rejected, and pressuring trading partners who look the other way on slave labor is a cause conservatives can defend on principle. But tariffs are still a tax that lands somewhere, and "the strategy hasn't changed, only the authority" is an honest admission worth remembering: the goal is leverage for better deals, not a permanent wall around the economy. Election Integrity6,600 NONCITIZENS WERE ADDED TO NEW JERSEY'S VOTER ROLLS, GOVERNOR SAYSWhat's Happening
* Gov. Mikie Sherrill says roughly **6,600 noncitizens** were registered to vote in New Jersey between 2023 and 2024 because of a Motor Vehicle Commission software error.
* The state says about **400** of those registrants improperly cast ballots.
* Officials describe it as an unintentional system failure rather than deliberate wrongdoing by the registrants.

The Situation
* Other states have begun reviewing their own voter-registration systems in the wake of the New Jersey disclosure.
* Sen. Tim Kaine, D-Va., called the error "not acceptable" and pointed to Virginia's voter-ID requirements as a safeguard.
* The episode has reignited the debate over voter ID even as a broader legislative package pairing it with a congressional stock-trading ban stalled in the House.

The PerspectiveA "glitch" that lets thousands of noncitizens onto the rolls is exactly why so many Americans want tighter verification — not because they assume mass fraud, but because a system that can't tell citizens from noncitizens erodes trust either way. It's worth being precise: a registration error is not the same as a proven fraud scheme, and there's no evidence 6,600 people conspired to vote illegally. Public SafetyTHREE KILLED IN SHOOTING AT SEATTLE'S "BITE OF SEATTLE" FESTIVALWhat's Happening
* Three people were killed and several others injured in a shooting Sunday night at the Bite of Seattle food festival at Seattle Center.
* The victims who died were a **19-year-old man, a 44-year-old man and a 56-year-old woman** ; a 2-year-old boy was among those injured.
* Police believe the gunfire stemmed from a shootout between two people; one suspect surrendered and is in custody while another fled and is being sought.

* Bite of Seattle is a free three-day event that draws more than 350,000 people, making a crowded public space the backdrop for the violence.
* The suspect in custody was described by police as "a young person" and was being questioned.
* Authorities were still working to confirm a motive and locate the second shooter as of the latest reports.

The PerspectiveThree lives ended and a toddler was wounded at a family festival — the kind of place that should be among the safest in any city. Two years ago this week, a bullet missed President Trump's head by a quarter of an inch.
Corey Comperatore — a husband, a father, and a Pennsylvania firefighter — wasn't as lucky. He died shielding his family from the gunfire.
America held its breath. And for a brief moment, Democrats said all the right things. Then they went right back to work.

[FIGHT BACK — SUPPORT A BALLOT CHASER](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e696320/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZfcmRsZi10cmFzX2JyXzIwMjYwNzIyLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3Mjc/LbmNsRW04Uzd6dw/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjMzMzBfd3IzJmFtb3VudD0xMDA/gamdbkQ/sbq919eba64)

_This_ is the Democrat Party:
🔴 **Hakeem Jeffries** called for _"maximum warfare, everywhere, all the time"_ just days before the WHCA shooting 🔴 **Chuck Schumer** called on supporters to _"forcefully rise up"_ against Trump 🔴 **Gavin Newsom** urged supporters to _"punch these sons of bitches in the mouth"_ 🔴 **Jimmy Kimmel** joked — days before the WHCA shooting — that Melania Trump had _"a glow, like an expectant widow"_

[WE WON'T BACK DOWN — HELP US FIGHT](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e696320/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZfcmRsZi10cmFzX2JyXzIwMjYwNzIyLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3Mjc/LbmNsRW04Uzd6dw/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjMzMzBfd3IzJmFtb3VudD0xMDA/gamdbkQ/sbq919eba64)
Patriot, we aren’t fighting a normal political opposition. We’re fighting a movement that thinks the America First agenda isn’t legitimate. That we aren’t worthy of peaceful coexistence.
We can’t let them win.

Audio unearthed **[by The Daily Wire](https://substack.com/redirect/cecf341b-ccb1-4f98-a2ac-62d674f4f927?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** shows Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico crediting Islamic mystics and poets like Rumi with shaping his faith as much as Christian writers, comments that contradict his recent New York Times interview describing his beliefs as rooted in "biblical Christianity." Talarico made the remarks during **[a 2024 podcast appearance](https://substack.com/redirect/ad352723-15c7-4b32-8106-6226c10e8dfc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** alongside a Muslim state legislator, saying interfaith dialogue "strengthens" rather than dilutes one's tradition.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/ad352723-15c7-4b32-8106-6226c10e8dfc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Talarico said:** "I know personally that I've learned as much about my faith from Salman's tradition, from the Islamic mystics, from poets like Rumi, as much as I have from Christian authors and Christian writers,... This kind of interfaith dialogue, it doesn't water down your tradition, in fact it strengthens it, it brings out new flavors and new colors."

* **Talarico 's broader religious statements have drawn scrutiny, including past comments describing God as "nonbinary,"** calling Jesus a "radical feminist," and attending a progressive Austin church that critics describe as far outside mainstream Christianity.

# **NBA star mocks Mamdani for Netanyahu manhunt**
Milwaukee Bucks forward Kyle Kuzma **[publicly mocked NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani](https://substack.com/redirect/20cd86cb-585a-4993-86a9-ffb27c2f2f0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as "a mayor playing president" after Mamdani released a video calling for Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's arrest under an International Criminal Court warrant ahead of the UN General Assembly. Kuzma accused Mamdani of prioritizing performative content over actual governance, writing that his generation was "learning the reward isn't in doing the thing; it's in looking like you did the thing."

clean_body: And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. | | | | Dear Friend, Will you help me put God back in your town schools? | | | They are wonderfully made in the very image of God. And that God is calling them to love Him above all else. What a country we'd be, if all of America's children had just a little bit of God's Word in their lives - like you did. Our Founding Fathers understood this. That's why throughout our history, the Bible has been the cornerstone of American life, education, and law. Abraham Lincoln believed the Bible was "the best gift God has given to man." And Dwight D. Eisenhower said, "Without God there could be no American form of government, nor an American way of life." But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. Justice Stewart Potter was the lone dissenter in the Supreme Court decision that outlawed the mandatory reading of the Bible in schools. He wrote that the ruling didn't 'protect religious freedom' but rather 'established a religion of secularism.' And how right he was! But even Justice Potter wouldn't have predicted how far the 'religion of secularism' has taken us from Biblical values. ...today radical "educators" teach our children and grandchildren that: God is a myth for the weak and if their families believe in Him, they're probably uneducated, hateful, and racist. If these "educators" do acknowledge God, they say He makes mistakes and some boys are really girls and some girls are really boys. And they wrongly tell children, 'God just wants you to be happy' so you should do whatever you want, do whatever feels good, and anyone who tells you otherwise is an old- fashioned bigot who has to go. So many families are being torn apart by this madness that overturns everything our Founders believed. It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools. Your signature on your "Schools Need a Bible Revival" petition tells our elected officials that you want biblical lessons put back in our public schools. Think public schools are too far gone? Think I'm dreaming? Consider this... BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group behind my "See You at the Library" movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left's "Drag Queen Story Hours." BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year! And BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish - and that America was founded upon - back into public schools this year! HOW? We've designed a mini-curriculum for America's 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation's Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. With you and BRAVE FOR GOOD behind me, I know we can expand that number to 250,000 children this year in honor of America's 250th Anniversary. You know it won't be easy. The radical leftists who've taken over our public schools aren't just going to put out the welcome mat. That's why BRAVE FOR GOOD is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. The 1963 ruling 100% allows for the Bible to be taught in a historical or cultural context! And why wouldn't it be? In every corner of the world, the Bible is considered one of the greatest books ever written. Of course children should learn about it in your taxpayer-funded schools! But radical educators will try to keep anything to do with the Bible out of our schools and when they do, BRAVE FOR GOOD will be ready to counter them with thousands of signed petitions. And will you please also consider a tax-deductible petition sponsorship gift of $35 or more? Every petition you send digitally must still be delivered, verified, securely collected, and tabulated before it can be presented -- That means your gift today puts hundreds of new voices on the record before the deadline. To be blunt, BRAVE FOR GOOD is a small but mighty Christian non-profit and this Bible Revival is funded entirely as a grassroots effort from patriots like you. It won't be easy going up against taxpayer-funded public schools and their unlimited money. But I know we can do it. Together with BRAVE FOR GOOD and patriots like you , we got conservative and patriotic values back into public libraries. Only God can lead our nation back to His Word. Thank you for standing with us. Sincerely, | | | Kirk Cameron BRAVE For Good | | | | ** Our best chance to put the biblical values our nation was founded upon back into schools is this year during America's 250th Anniversary so please hurry. | | | BRAVE FOR GOOD is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Your gift is tax-deductible to the full extent allowed by law.

Peter, This past July 4 wasn’t just America’s birthday. It was also the day that Elon Musk’s brainchild, the so-called “Department of Government Efficiency” (DOGE), officially closed up shop. Not a moment too soon. DOGE leaves behind a legacy of chaos and devastation, including an estimated 700,000 deaths so far from cuts to USAID. Musk once claimed that DOGE could save taxpayers $2 trillion. In the end, federal spending actually _increased_ under DOGE. And DOGE did lasting damage by supporting the MAGA movement’s assault on democracy:
* Plotting to secretly deliver sensitive voter data to extremists trying to overturn election results — while the Trump administration has tried to seize states’ voter rolls.
* Cutting funding for election security.
* Depleting the Census Bureau’s staff by about 1,500 employees — an agency that needs to be fully ready to conduct a fair count in 2030 and help shape fair maps for the next decade.

[**At the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, we fight back against MAGA’s attacks on free and fair elections, defend the census from partisan manipulation, and work to make sure that the will of the people prevails — with fair maps and fair access to the ballot box. Donate now to power this democracy-saving work.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136072705/636275830/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_Doge_email_20260727-NDRC-Tier1-Doge_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260727-NDRC-Tier1-Doge_&utm_campaign=Doge&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI1ZGU3MTBhLWM5ODktZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=pBKNzM5pDxI-gcyi8I9PUFnkfneim4DPvIIoKUCoNEs=) Back in the early days of DOGE last spring, Elon Musk’s political machine dumped tens of millions of dollars into a Wisconsin Supreme Court race to try to affect the Badger State’s redistricting process. But supporters like you fought back, one grassroots donation at a time — defeating Musk’s handpicked candidate and protecting a pro-democracy majority on the Court. Musk is spending big again on the 2026 elections in order to lock in unearned power from mid-decade redraws and lay the groundwork for many more. And up against a concerted effort from the Trump administration, we’re fighting to ensure a fair count in the next census — while we’re _also_ in the middle of a nationwide MAGA redistricting crisis. In the end, federal spending actually increased under DOGE. And DOGE did lasting damage by supporting the MAGA movement’s assault on democracy: Plotting to secretly deliver sensitive voter data to extremists trying to overturn election results — while the Trump administration has tried to seize states’ voter rolls. Cutting funding for election security. | | | | |
Before I get into the week’s schedule, I wanted to let you know that we are now in the final 100 days of the campaign.

100 days left before this year's election.15,000 miles traveled.Dozens of town halls and meetings.Hundreds of conversations.
One message everywhere I go: North Dakotans are hurting. [**Now is the time to get involved, to donate, to volunteer.**](https://us.list-manage.com/12ssuYkPx2P?e=37dda778f5&c2id=cdbf6368064ed4acbe3dc3fec7c073dc)
Now, here’s what’s coming up for me on the trail this week:
**Mon. 7/27** • Riverview Dairy tour**Tue. 7/28** • Farmers Appreciation Banquet - Jamestown**Wed. 7/29** • Fundraiser in Bismarck**Thu. 7/30** • Statewide Candidate Forum - Rugby**Fri. 7/31**
• Farmer’s Breakfast - Rugby**Sa. 8/1** • Maddock 125 Year Celebration
**Su. 8/2**
• Maybe I’ll come visit you!

---
My statement from Facebook about Trump’s executive order:
Hyperscale Data Centers: David versus GoliathPresident Trump has signed Executive Order 14318. The order fast-tracks mega hyperscale data centers over 100 MW development. This now feels like David versus Goliath. The most powerful person in the world has weighed in on a major issue North Dakotans are living with every day. In North Dakota we believe in local control, right down to the township. We believe in property rights. That isn't a Red Team versus Blue Team issue. That's a North Dakota people issue. I and others have called for a moratorium on hyperscale data center development until the full impacts are understood.What This Executive Order Means for Local Communities:The order fast-tracks development of North Dakota data centers over 100 MW and the pipelines, transmission lines, substations, and water systems required to support them. It speeds up federal approvals and shortens environmental reviews. That means local governments and landowners will have less time, less leverage, and fewer tools to evaluate multi-billion‐dollar projects that could reshape their communities. Let me be clear: This isn't about stopping technology. It's about property rights, transparency, and local control. Rural counties deserve a real say before billion-dollar projects move forward at lightning speed.A moratorium isn't anti-development—it's pro-due-process. It gives communities the time to understand the costs, the infrastructure demands, and the long-term consequences before decisions are made for them.Sunshine before speed. Local control before federal shortcuts. This executive order makes our work even more important. I won't back down fighting for your rights. We may feel like David in this fight with Goliath, but remember David won that battle in the end. Our elected officials at the Capitol are siding with Goliath, yet together, we will make a difference. Stay strong; we must not give up this honorable quest!Click on the comment section to read the Executive Order and our Responsible Hyperscale Development Framework (RHDF)

To find out more about these events, follow us on [**Facebook**](https://us.list-manage.com/H61pjdptnTZ?e=37dda778f5&c2id=cdbf6368064ed4acbe3dc3fec7c073dc)!

This campaign is still on a roll and is nothing without your help. I really appreciate all the support!
Sincerely,
Vern

We must not allow our election policies to be driven by misinformation. We’re fighting back by getting accurate election information into the hands of voters nationwide, registering them to vote, and empowering Americans to make our voices heard at the ballot box.
There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access. Team,
We are asking you to chip in $4 to GIFFORDS PAC ahead of Friday’s end-of-month fundraising deadline in four days.
Yes, you read that right — just $4. You might be asking why.
Well, that’s because there are four Democrats running for the U.S. Senate in November’s midterms, and the outcome of these races will decide whether we can win back a gun sense majority.
_If you need a reminder, they are Jon Ossoff in Georgia, James Talarico in Texas, Sherrod Brown in Ohio, and Roy Cooper in North Carolina._
National Republicans are already spending millions of dollars to air nonstop attack ads against these four leaders. GIFFORDS is working to help persuade undecided voters in swing races like these, but we need your help in these final weeks.
**That’s why we’re asking you to pitch in $4 to help us elect Democrats like these everywhere.**
