Hi there Peter, it's Michele Tafoya!

If I were to take a guess, there's a 50/50 chance you may recognize me from a stadium's big screen.
If that's not the case, I get it... Let me at least tell you briefly about who I am and what I'm about anyway!

I should clarify first, no, I didn't make my career running for touchdowns or kicking game-winning field goals.

I worked as a sideline reporter in professional football for nearly three decades. Working in the sport for that long was a dream come true, and I wouldn't have wanted it any other way.
[Believe me, I know plenty of people who called me crazy for walking away from a career I loved. But life is short, and I was not willing to sit on the sidelines while everything I care about was on the line.](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/U6xL-nuZgKSDYKCHEg3s--qhstqUH9_iqiGxfrbUK4G_Syt5wpqCw3d6-TAiWvCpf2WfOT5f-cmeuwWunp9A5WKkJkeZpl7G9XTno5FGg26Ccz1HghzoIKJ2WnYyZ8ECU6vAT95GruwenmeueJgZgmDM-l-jrIGZzoJcTXMSm1znUHjxVL90TbuxlGA6Zqlp9Pd-h4rhBTQVA-ybUcmuB8HOUTY13rPD_xxFOXV686pEUwXaUvPX9Nf9-QRYoPpz5afTnDtkgkDvJuToCmz_y62YoVAclNGbJbBBInH9ywjoPxPunC_duO-Fu1ZdAMpZbi-GpJtkpxAw3AbXorNO1JGS2HupzgpgYiFNL6ahyKlpWp7ZYImzv9cuOLgjkMU0iHiT-llwk_zvaundEwP3JpWSvXHe01qBF7Otu7BGMUflOf_O94UerB4G-5pDFIcYgmgJNSpY98RzYVcL22r0kfCQL8r8CmPLHZg_9SVBKQmm2r3f2qqQuj614dEr8c20TVvvuyEGQpvAzmZPUWhx132AWYmwnzrZWHwyaDIY8ZMvaTFjJfvWegDauItR-Jc2CZHSeSh20Pv9CsRKsytuspq-I-yLZiibgi1UywdlCnGN9570fef9OXYopK4KEmaA2Pj4suIRpXFisoU2W9FSjLILztRZQK0G4JYWv6JjuBy8nBan2-6IER9dsTkgR-dWjHql5dUZdMu0v636EsDKu_zZS6lDQi4clvdn4BnyMtywPjuhcAgRYLUW5-yfvxq5-BbeOxhdlUJXmbOkatqfbSeBVSQL2tWg7VQhZol8RmpGqR_5Vxyc-iljFLQ2G53ULZAlF68WdXGLP_LVpNkPk4NEOSmY-C3AKuqSIxi3Gw/wVZP-3CEOU6jAGBaNtIVGXqThHGeQfTI/23)
I told myself before I officially launched my race for U.S. Senate that we had to be all in or not do it at all.

I burned the boats, Peter, and there's absolutely no looking back.
I will not be canceled. I will not apologize for values that are wholesome and good. And if my voice gives someone else the courage to use theirs, that is exactly why I did it.

I want my daughter and every young American to know one thing:
You earn your place. You think for yourself. And you never let anyone put you in a box. That's the Minnesota I'm fighting for.
Parents who speak up are called transphobes.Girls who lose opportunities are told to be quiet.And women's groups are nowhere to be found.
This is not complicated.
Girls' sports are for girls, and boys' sports are for boys.

The radical Left has done everything in its power to infiltrate some of the most vulnerable minds in our society. I launched this run because just like you, I'm sick of the indoctrination and want to bring back sanity to our country.

It's going to be FAR from easy. Minnesota hasn't had a Republican Senator in nearly two decades! However, it's ripe for a flip....with the disastrous leadership of Governor Walz and the Democratic Party in the state, people are fed up.

It's going to take a grassroots army of patriots, just like you, to propel this movement of ours to victory and shock the world.

| | We are excited to share that the application for our upcoming NextWave Regional Bootcamp for the Midwest Region is NOW LIVE!
The [**NextWave Midwestern Regional Bootcamp**](https://us.list-manage.com/84g0uIg9Ywb?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)**will be held in Chicago, IL, from August 26 - 28th**. We are seeking applicants who are interested in, or currently working on, campaigns or for state parties in the Midwest. [**The application will be open until Monday, August 3, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET.**](https://us.list-manage.com/HEztWvuekox?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)
The DNC NextWave Regional Bootcamp is a new, **free training program** that serves to strengthen the pipeline for the next generation of campaign and party staff and prepare them to win down-ballot races for 2026 and beyond.
This three-day, in-person training program provides participants with specialized training based on their campaign experience level and connects them with other campaign talent and professionals in their region. Four NextWave Regional Bootcamps will be held throughout the country in 2026.
**NextWave Regional Bootcamp Tracks** : Participants are placed into one of two tracks to maximize their experience at NextWave:
1. **Campaigns 101:** for current or aspiring field organizers, fellows, and campaign associates with less than two cycles of experience who are looking to strengthen their skills and get exposure to new aspects of campaign and state party work.
2. **Management Track:** for mid-level and senior campaign and state party professionals who understand the technical aspects of campaign work but are looking to expand their skills as managers and leaders in the Democratic ecosystem.

In addition to hands-on training, participants will also have the opportunity to network with other campaign professionals and learn about campaign and state party job opportunities in their region.
---
| [APPLY HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/K4O7PsCa_vC?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)
---
| | The DNC will prioritize applicants from the following states for the NextWave Midwestern Regional Bootcamp: Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Dakota, and Wisconsin.
After their acceptances, participants will have the opportunity to request lodging support from the DNC for the duration of the training program. Some lodging support may be provided to attendees who need it, but this is not guaranteed. The DNC is unable to provide additional travel support outside of lodging.

| Estimated Read Time: 3 Minutes Just The Truth Your No-BS Newsletter Dear Readers, Today's sponsor, Darline Graham, is asking for your support as she campaigns for the U.S. Senate in South Carolina following President Trump's endorsement and ahead of the August 11 Special Election Primary. Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors.

Friend, this race is heating up, so before I ask you to **[make an urgent donation toward my End-of-Month goal](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/12595?refcode=jtk1103-fr-nd&t=2&akid=11313%2E400544%2EYGxd5e)** , I'd like to share how I got here and what I am fighting for.
I am the proud descendant of generations of fierce Pueblo women. Their strength and resilience gave me the courage to run for office and fight for New Mexicans, including standing up to Donald Trump.
**I made history as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. And _when_ we win this race, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state. **
**But for me, this work has never been about titles or being the first.**
It’s about fighting for working families, standing up for New Mexicans, and making sure more people have a seat at the table. I want to leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders and build a government that truly reflects and fights for the people it serves. Higher wages. Lower costs. Stronger education so our kids can read earlier. Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico so you can see a doctor even when you’re not sick. Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare and housing stability so we can make our communities safer.
__**That's just a quick look into my vision for the future of New Mexico and our country, and now, I'm asking you to invest in it. I truly believe there's nothing we can't accomplish if we work together, and I need you with me now more than ever._[So please, friend, can I count on you to chip in $5 or more before the End-of-Month deadline in 4 days to help me fight for working families, deliver real progress for New Mexicans, and leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/12595?refcode=jtk1103-fr-nd&t=3&akid=11313%2E400544%2EYGxd5e)_**

# [$700M woke rebrand disaster finally costs Cracker Barrel CEO ](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[her job](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8ac1c2d7-7efa-44fb-a943-5914224f1435?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Cracker Barrel announced Monday that **[woke CEO Julie Masino will step down](https://substack.com/redirect/f482f86d-b5b5-48d8-9fac-b5c6a6e54452?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/f482f86d-b5b5-48d8-9fac-b5c6a6e54452?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)effective Aug. 10 and be replaced by David Deno after a $700 million rebrand that sparked co-founder criticism, Trump comments and **[diner food quality complaints.](https://substack.com/redirect/0b0db225-d3c1-4e64-94fb-3486b0b23d98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
**Co-founder criticizes leadership knowledge:** Tommy Lowe, 93, said Masino knows very little about the history and food, calling the $700 million redo **[the biggest waste of money after more than $140 million in market value loss.](https://substack.com/redirect/77d947e8-9755-4d36-a5a9-2d95d61bfbbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
**Trump demands logo restoration:** President Donald Trump **[posted that Cracker Barrel should go back to the old logo,](https://substack.com/redirect/dcb7ef5f-8f7e-4023-a49b-61fae7ad9c97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** admit a mistake based on customer response and manage the company better than ever before.
**Diners report food quality drops:** Longtime patrons complained of chilled biscuits baked in larger batches, reheated green beans and sides, and watered-down syrup as the company moved to reinstate some favorite items.
**Quarterly results trail prior year:** First-quarter sales fell 5.7% with adjusted EBITDA at $7.2 million versus $45.8 million earlier, as Masino stated the recovery will take time to regain guest trust.

# [Nvidia launches AI safety alliance after OpenAI agent goes rogue](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia, Microsoft, SpaceX and dozens of firms **[launched the Open Secure AI Alliance on Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/a44677fa-1da4-427a-8692-5ecc3058c2fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** focused on open models after an OpenAI autonomous agent hacked Hugging Face and **[the company took a week to realize it.](https://substack.com/redirect/f7cfc613-6eed-4190-aff2-52692eff275f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Alliance prioritizes open technologies:** The group including Nvidia, Microsoft, SpaceX and Palantir will remediate and disclose vulnerabilities using open technologies, with Nvidia citing the Hugging Face incident as proof defenders need open agentic systems.
* **OpenAI delayed agent recognition:** OpenAI did not realize its agent was responsible for the July 11-13 Hugging Face breach until July 16 after a blog post, after the target had already contacted the FBI.
* **Closed models failed defense:** Hugging Face could not use leading U.S. frontier models to defend itself because guardrails did not distinguish aggressor from defender and instead used a self-hosted Chinese open-weight model.
* **Industry resists model restrictions:** The launch follows tech firms urging against premature restrictions on open-weight models amid Washington debate and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent threats of sanctions over distillation attacks.

# [Chinese labs secretly distill America's top AI models at scale](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Distillation, the practice of using outputs from advanced AI models to train others, **[has become a hot-button issue from Silicon Valley to Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/009a07e4-2d43-451c-bd94-cdd59601546b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Chinese lab Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 proved competitive with leading U.S. systems.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8ac1c2d7-7efa-44fb-a943-5914224f1435?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **White House alleges model theft:** Advisor Michael Kratsios said Moonshot distilled Anthropic's Fable model using a sophisticated internal platform for large-scale extraction against U.S. systems to develop its Kimi K3.
* **Tech giants urge open access:** Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, Palantir and more than 20 firms released a letter Friday urging policymakers to avoid premature restrictions on open-weight models that would stifle competition.
* **Anthropic flags industrial scale:** The company reported Chinese firms used about 24,000 fake accounts generating 16 million exchanges to distill Claude capabilities, calling the practice a national security matter.
* **Technique has legitimate uses:** Distillation remains a widely used method for making smaller models more capable from frontier systems, as Google AI lead Jeff Dean discussed earlier and Nvidia applied in its own processes.

# [Nvidia and SK Hynix seal $500B pact in the AI arms race](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia **[secured AI memory supply from SK Hynix](https://substack.com/redirect/d48da92f-9e5a-4d18-ad2e-83537c0f7e52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in an agreement potentially worth $500 billion over years that includes large-scale data centers expected online in 2027 amid a global high-bandwidth memory shortage.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive capacity target set:** SK Telecom will build a cloud business using Nvidia's Vera Rubin systems with Nvidia targeting enough capacity to require 2 gigawatts of power for hundreds of thousands of GPUs.
* **Co-development of next memory:** Nvidia enterprise vice president Raj Mirpuri said the expansion includes a co-develop opportunity on next-generation SK Hynix AI memory to help secure stable HBM supply.
* **Additional Korean investments:** Nvidia will invest $1 billion into Naver for data centers around its GPUs, providing capacity before 200 megawatts is completed for customers in South Korea and worldwide.
* **Parallel Samsung Broadcom deal:** Samsung Electronics signed a memorandum of understanding with Broadcom estimated at $200 billion to expand collaboration across memory and foundry technologies for next-generation AI infrastructure.

# [Crypto firms ditch Bitcoin for AI after market freefall](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Digital-asset treasury firms **[are pivoting to artificial intelligence and data centers](https://substack.com/redirect/2d30f30b-6a96-4c7b-97c0-2199d3b0a339?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in a bid to win back investors after the crypto market implosion, though the stock performance of early movers has so far been poor.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Multiple firms already shifted:** K Wave Media shares fell 71% since its May reboot from Bitcoin accumulation to data centers, while Lixte Biotechnology dropped 33% after a June battery firm merger.
* **Rebrand also underperforms:** AlphaTON Capital, which held alternative cryptocurrencies, has dropped 33% since rebranding as Alpha Compute Corp. in April amid the broader treasury stock slump.
* **AI attracts capital flows:** The spending from Alphabet, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic has made data-center related companies the best performing stocks in the S&P 500 in 2026, including SanDisk up more than 500%.
* **More pivots still coming:** Law firms that brought many digital-asset treasury companies to market last year report continued interest in switching to AI as the vast majority of the firms try to switch gears or are dying.

# [Ford drops limited Bronco run in sneaker style "Vehicle drop"](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Ford is expanding its accessory and parts business to boost profits and tap the $53 billion U.S. aftermarket, **[launching its first Ford Custom Garage"vehicle drop"](https://substack.com/redirect/5bc82dbe-1fd9-445d-b579-b7606fa97fb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/5bc82dbe-1fd9-445d-b579-b7606fa97fb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Monday with a limited desert sunrise-inspired Bronco.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/837e5f09-7a04-401b-b5b8-756b110825c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Limited edition now available:** The automaker will produce 1,000 of the Bronco models with the Desert Rising package priced at $13,695, bringing the total vehicle price to $57,350 as part of the new Bronco Horizon Series.
* **Packages reach higher prices:** Full customization packages through Ford Custom Garage start at thousands of dollars and can run up to $16,000 to $18,000 for Mustang performance versions and nearly $27,000 for a special F-150.
* **Growth target for services:** Ford is targeting 8% annual growth through the end of the decade in its $15 billion high-margin software and physical services revenue, which includes the customization business.
* **Buyer customization rates high:** Ford reports 46% of its new vehicle buyers in the U.S. customize their vehicles in some way, with Bronco buyers leading followed by Mustang and pickup truck customers.

Nvidia in an agreement potentially worth $500 billion over years that includes large-scale data centers expected online in 2027 amid a global high-bandwidth memory shortage. | | ---|---|--- Massive capacity target set: SK Telecom will build a cloud business using Nvidia's Vera Rubin systems with Nvidia targeting enough capacity to require 2 gigawatts of power for hundreds of thousands of GPUs. Co-development of next memory: Nvidia enterprise vice president Raj Mirpuri said the expansion includes a co-develop opportunity on next-generation SK Hynix AI memory to help secure stable HBM supply. Additional Korean investments: Nvidia will invest $1 billion into Naver for data centers around its GPUs, providing capacity before 200 megawatts is completed for customers in South Korea and worldwide. Parallel Samsung Broadcom deal: Samsung Electronics signed a memorandum of understanding with Broadcom estimated at $200 billion to expand collaboration across memory and foundry technologies for next-generation AI infrastructure. Digital-asset treasury firms in a bid to win back investors after the crypto market implosion, though the stock performance of early movers has so far been poor. | | ---|---|--- Multiple firms already shifted: K Wave Media shares fell 71% since its May reboot from Bitcoin accumulation to data centers, while Lixte Biotechnology dropped 33% after a June battery firm merger. Rebrand also underperforms: AlphaTON Capital, which held alternative cryptocurrencies, has dropped 33% since rebranding as Alpha Compute Corp. in April amid the broader treasury stock slump. AI attracts capital flows: The spending from Alphabet, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic has made data-center related companies the best performing stocks in the S&P 500 in 2026, including SanDisk up more than 500%. More pivots still coming: Law firms that brought many digital-asset treasury companies to market last year report continued interest in switching to AI as the vast majority of the firms try to switch gears or are dying. Ford is expanding its accessory and parts business to boost profits and tap the $53 billion U.S. aftermarket, with a limited desert sunrise-inspired Bronco. | | ---|---|--- Limited edition now available: The automaker will produce 1,000 of the Bronco models with the Desert Rising package priced at $13,695, bringing the total vehicle price to $57,350 as part of the new Bronco Horizon Series. Packages reach higher prices: Full customization packages through Ford Custom Garage start at thousands of dollars and can run up to $16,000 to $18,000 for Mustang performance versions and nearly $27,000 for a special F-150. Growth target for services: Ford is targeting 8% annual growth through the end of the decade in its $15 billion high-margin software and physical services revenue, which includes the customization business. Buyer customization rates high: Ford reports 46% of its new vehicle buyers in the U.S. customize their vehicles in some way, with Bronco buyers leading followed by Mustang and pickup truck customers. **ICYMI: “Rats & Resumes” Highlight Opioid Lobbyist Cinde Warmington’s Disqualifying Record**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** July 27th, 2026
---
| | | **CONTACT****karina@nhrsc.com**
---
| |
CONCORD, N.H. —**** Last week, the New Hampshire Republican State Committee displayed a 10-foot inflatable rat outside the State House and distributed copies of a resume highlighting Opioid Lobbyist Cinde Warmington’s decades-long record of putting the opioid industry and her own self-interest ahead of Granite States. Coverage of the event ran on [WMUR](https://us.list-manage.com/wWiOJkvt4Hl?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=gpAS_8pUbt0RJFJG-WB2O3wPAHe9jSXUktHaHd6K44AlIQM56Udpyx07Ew==), and the display was also featured in the July 25, 2026, edition of the “State House Dome” column in the Union Leader. This follows Warmington’s resume appearing on Page A3 of the [_Union Leader_](https://us.list-manage.com/UBcVvHvQUN0?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=BEjpGu6zIeJ_-oroYz6g_MGMrqKdzALj4Ok6aVopAi_tq4hcFONftkvIjA==) in the paper’s July 18, 2026, edition.

---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1CqHlb9d73w?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=EF6CeNMJ_sQSNUlvzcsL5ghTD1n4Ri2q2k_CnwpHPW6Bh9t9QizajNDLjw==)
| | | | | | | | | | | |
Transcript: _Republicans put up this 10 foot inflatable rat in front of the state house today, targeting Democratic candidate for governor Cinde Warmington.____The rat, which carried a sign reading “Opioid Lobbyist Warmington”, is intended to bring more attention to her prior work at the state house, on behalf of Purdue Pharma, the makers of oxycontin two decades ago._

---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
The resume details Warmington’s work lobbying for Purdue Pharma while promoting OxyContin as a “miracle drug” and opposing safeguards on the drug, as well as her representation of entities associated with notorious pill mill owner Michael O’Connell. It also outlines her efforts to defeat legislation benefiting O’Connell before later receiving nearly $50,000 in campaign contributions from him, along with statements from recovery advocates, law enforcement leaders, firefighters, and community members who have called her record disqualifying.

| | Last year, I helped pass the Epstein Files Transparency Act. It was a hard-won bipartisan law that required the Department of Justice to release records related to Jeffrey Epstein's sex trafficking operation — while protecting the identities of victims. Here's what actually happened instead: Trump's DOJ released millions of pages, but they didn't immediately release all relevant files and incorrectly redacted others. They left victims exposed — publishing information that could identify survivors — while heavily redacting the names of powerful people who may have been involved. That's not the transparency the American people deserve. **So earlier this month, I helped introduce a new bipartisan bill: the Epstein Files Transparency Act II.** Here's what it does:
* **Gives impacted folks the right to sue.** State attorneys general, members of Congress, and Epstein's victims themselves can now take the DOJ to court for failure to comply with the law by properly and fully disclosing these records.

* **Puts survivors back in control.** Victims get the right to obtain full, unredacted records about themselves — no more finding out what the government knows about your own abuse from a leaked file.

* **Closes the loopholes.** The bill bans DOJ from hiding behind "deliberative process privilege" — bureaucratic language they've used to dodge disclosure.

* **Arms local prosecutors.** State and local law enforcement get access to unredacted records they need to actually investigate and prosecute.

As long as officials in Washington keep protecting the Epstein Class instead of Epstein survivors, nothing changes. This bill forces accountability through the courts. Survivors have waited long enough. It's time for real justice. It was a hard-won bipartisan law that required the Department of Justice to release records related to Jeffrey Epstein's sex trafficking operation — while protecting the identities of victims. Here's what actually happened instead: Trump's DOJ released millions of pages, but they didn't immediately release all relevant files and incorrectly redacted others. They left victims exposed — publishing information that could identify survivors — while heavily redacting the names of powerful people who may have been involved. That's not the transparency the American people deserve. So earlier this month, I helped introduce a new bipartisan bill: the Epstein Files Transparency Act II. Here's what it does: Gives impacted folks the right to sue. State attorneys general, members of Congress, and Epstein's victims themselves can now take the DOJ to court for failure to comply with the law by properly and fully disclosing these records. Puts survivors back in control. Victims get the right to obtain full, unredacted records about themselves — no more finding out what the government knows about your own abuse from a leaked file. Closes the loopholes. The bill bans DOJ from hiding behind "deliberative process privilege" — bureaucratic language they've used to dodge disclosure. Arms local prosecutors. State and local law enforcement get access to unredacted records they need to actually investigate and prosecute. As long as officials in Washington keep protecting the Epstein Class instead of Epstein survivors, nothing changes. This bill forces accountability through the courts. Survivors have waited long enough. It's time for real justice. name: Michael Baumgartner
subject: Fresh from the Trail: This week's campaign update!

body:
Your Vote Counts, Davenport Parade, Sign-waving, and More!

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/cruChEVeK9l?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| [DONATE](https://us.list-manage.com/12mSn04Zrti?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
---
|
---
| |
# Every Vote Counts!
---
|
---
| |

**Please VOTE - and remind your friends!******_**Only 8 days remain until the Primary Election. If you haven’t voted yet, don’t wait! Make your plan and return your ballot today! **_
Every ballot returned over the next 8 days will help determine the future of Eastern Washington. I encourage everyone across our region to make your voice heard by casting your ballot. Voting is one of the greatest privileges we have as Americans, and your vote in this election is an opportunity to shape the future of our communities, our state, and our nation.
If your ballot is still sitting on the kitchen counter, fill it out and return it today. Please encourage your family, friends, and neighbors to do the same.
**Together, let’s finish strong. Every vote counts!**
---
|
---
| |
# A Great Day in Davenport
---
|
---
| |
My team and I had a great time at the Davenport Pioneer Days Parade. It was a pleasure waving to families along the parade route, visiting with neighbors, and celebrating community spirit.
Thank you to everyone who came out to cheer on the parade and stopped to say hello - and especially to our fantastic volunteers for taking the time to support the campaign.
Thank you for the warm welcome and I look forward to visiting again soon!
---
|
---
|
---
| |
# Waving the Way to Victory
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/17Ke__V1VAR?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| |
One of the most enjoyable parts of campaigning is joining our incredible volunteers for sign waving across the district. Whether drivers honk, wave, or give us a thumbs up, it's always encouraging to see so many members of our community engaged in the election process!
---
| |
A heartfelt thank you to everyone who spent time holding signs and helping spread our message. Your dedication and enthusiasm make a real difference, and I'm truly grateful for all you do to support our campaign.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
# “Super Saturday” Door-Knocking in
# Liberty Lake
---
| | | |

---
Our team, some wonderful volunteers, and I spent a great afternoon knocking on doors and talking with voters in the Liberty Lake community. There's no substitute for meeting people face-to-face, listening to their concerns, and having meaningful conversations about the issues that matter most.

Thank you to everyone who walked with us, and to everyone who welcomed us at their door and shared their thoughts. Hearing directly from you is one of the most rewarding parts of campaigning.
|
---
| |
# Volunteer Spotlight:
# Tom
---
|
---
| |
Every campaign has a few people you can always count on, and for us, Tom is at the top of the list. You’ll find him out waving signs with enough enthusiasm to make even the Monday morning commute a little brighter! When he’s not earning honks and thumbs-up from passing drivers, he is serving as one of our campaign observers. His keen eye helps ensure the election process is fair and transparent.
Tom’s commitment, reliability, and servant’s heart are the kind of qualities that make this campaign stronger every single day. I’m incredibly thankful for everything he does and proud to have him on Team Baumgartner.

---
|
---
| |
# Ballots Are Out: We Need Your Help!
---
| | With only **8 days** left in this primary season, time is of the essence! Join us **Saturday August 1st** in Spokane Valley for another Super Saturday door-knocking extravaganza! **Say YES! to help us reach the finish line successfully. Email Stephanie **[**here**](mailto:stephanie@votebaumgartner.com?subject=Super%20Saturday%20Door-Knocking!&body=)** for more details!**
---
|
---
| | More campaign signs will be going up over these next few weeks. _**Will you host a yard sign? **_Click [**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/IOqXnP0JHPa?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238) to sign up now, or just send an email reply!We need volunteers! If you have a couple of hours to spare, please reach out to us! Visit our [**website**](https://us.list-manage.com/IX99I1tKzKs?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)**** to sign up now for opportunities, from attending parades or knocking on doors, to making phone calls or writing letters.**Upcoming Events** Team Baumgartner is on the move across Eastern Washington, connecting with neighbors and celebrating traditions that make our communities strong. Here is where you can find us next:

**Saturday August 1: **Hillyard Days Parade, Spokane 10 am: We’ll be rolling through Hillyard with flags flying and high-fives ready. Come join us!**Saturday August 1: **Super Saturday Door Knocking 2-5 pm: Join us for an afternoon of door-knocking in Spokane Valley. Nothing beats a personal conversation when it comes to getting folks fired up to vote. [**JOIN US!**](https://us.list-manage.com/fEB5V7SqElD?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)**Tuesday August 4:** Ballots are DUE: Make a plan to vote. Drop Boxes close at 8 pm- every vote counts. Better yet - vote early!
[T](https://us.list-manage.com/KaLPmEd6DUe?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)hank you for all your encouragement and support! -Michael

body:
How badly does Donald Trump have to f*** things up in Iran before Republicans in Congress finally take away his credit card?
| | | | |

This is despite the fact that Trump has no f***ing clue what he’s doing. body:
Please don't skip this 1-minute read. It's Monday July 27 and we have some critical primaries coming up in a few days

**Folks... I am worried. Heaven help us if we lose in November. We may have enjoyed our last free and fair election. That is why I am asking you to donate to the Michigan Democratic Party -- a state with several critical House and Senate races who will have spent down to nothing to win next week's primaries.**

---|---

Please don't skip this 1-minute read. It's Monday July 27, and one of the most important primaries of the election comes to a close in Michigan in just a few days.

If you have ever found yourself wishing there was some check on Donald Trump's power, then that means you know the stakes of this election.

The truth is, there are some big primaries happening next week in Michigan. And when they are done the Democratic candidates in some competitive races will have spent down to zero while their Republican opponents have millions in the bank. That's why this message is so important.

I am asking, humbly, for you to join the 2% of Democrats getting this message who will donate to the Michigan Democratic Party today -- a state that will play an outsized role in determining who controls the House and Senate.
---

Folks, if you are angry about what is happening in this country, then we all have a role to play in doing something about it. And there is probably nothing more important we can do than everything we can to take back the House and Senate.

And heaven help us if we lose in November and there is no check on Trump -- we may very well have had our last free and fair election in this country.
---

So while I don't plan on sending a million fundraising emails going forward, this one was important enough to ask, especially before next week's primary.

[**If taking back the House and Senate is important to you, please make a $3 contribution to the Michigan Democratic Party today. | | Dear Friend,

I wonder if you agree with me:

Far too many young people do not know the meaning and purpose of the U.S. Constitution!

At Hillsdale College, every undergraduate student must pass a course on the U.S. Constitution before graduating.

That's rare today. In fact, most colleges and universities don't have this essential course.

The class is also life-changing for many of our young students.

Recently, a student told her professor she "loved this class" because she had **never been taught the Constitution in high school.**

This young lady was well-educated in high school, accomplished, and smart. Yet she had never learned about the Constitution--one of our most important founding documents!

Sadly, this happens more often than you think.

And it is one reason why misunderstandings about the Constitution, and the liberty that it safeguards, are widespread in our country.

To help Americans of all ages learn what the Constitution actually says, Hillsdale College created the National Quiz on the U.S. Constitution. Maybe you'd like to test your constitutional knowledge?

**If so, here 's a secure link for you:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/constitution-quiz**](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskcFq3DAQQL9GvtlII3u1PvjQ4rhQkl1KCz0arTS2B2TJtcabtF9fUhLIB_Q6j3nDY34-jU-WAsX5Ylfs-GVKo0dPzjL6MeJzDsiM-7imzJkPj5FzxDvuAe0eeaERJJxKaUowHzZV4bub9K0qsFPm3CjTaCmLpZNnlC14bPxN1fIEtlVKQ9sC1E7eGlNQ9yqUBow6S6VNdQNnJ2x13Uytl16JWqInTnvFCzK-2DyF3-mOe-XSWoRuYd6y0J8EDAIGilOqFgohexuwQn8IGFyKmYkPphTLXwf9EXrITuheyrZuLhJqePz6ub_2Dw_fBZwOXsecjt2h0P22p7yhY4rzG1rR07EK3eNqKbwNnV03S3MUuv947Z2myBhZ6P7xevkyfjPlj-FavocXe-e3ZwqB8smIWs6v3n91_D8_dO_gbwAAAP__nf-r6g)

And when you're done, you can take our popular **FREE online course, "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution,"** taught by the same faculty who teach students on our campus.

We produce these educational resources and offer them at no cost because millions of Americans should understand the principles of liberty that make our country so great and so free.

Do you share that belief?

If you do, I hope you'll also consider including a **tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, or even $100 after taking the quiz.**

Own it now. ** | | | | | MONDAY, JULY 27, 2026 Dear Texas Flyover Reader, At The Flyover, we believe one of the best parts of living in America is taking the time to understand the history and principles that have shaped our country. Staying informed helps us better appreciate the freedoms we enjoy and the responsibilities that come with them. That's why today's sponsor, , is inviting readers to test their knowledge with a free U.S. Constitution quiz and explore educational resources designed to deepen your understanding of America's founding. Learn more below. -Cole, CEO | | | | | | Dear Friend, I wonder if you agree with me: Far too many young people do not know the meaning and purpose of the U.S. Constitution! At Hillsdale College, every undergraduate student must pass a course on the U.S. Constitution before graduating. That's rare today. In fact, most colleges and universities don't have this essential course. The class is also life-changing for many of our young students. Recently, a student told her professor she "loved this class" because she had never been taught the Constitution in high school. This young lady was well-educated in high school, accomplished, and smart. Yet she had never learned about the Constitution--one of our most important founding documents! Sadly, this happens more often than you think. And it is one reason why misunderstandings about the Constitution, and the liberty that it safeguards, are widespread in our country. To help Americans of all ages learn what the Constitution actually says, Hillsdale College created the National Quiz on the U.S. Constitution. Maybe you'd like to test your constitutional knowledge? If so, here 's a secure link for you: It's short, enjoyable, and revealing. And when you're done, you can take our popular FREE online course, "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution," taught by the same faculty who teach students on our campus. We produce these educational resources and offer them at no cost because millions of Americans should understand the principles of liberty that make our country so great and so free. Do you share that belief? If you do, I hope you'll also consider including a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, or even $100 after taking the quiz. Your support helps us offer " Constitution 101" and other free constitution-defending educational resources to millions--especially young people. Take your quiz here: Thank you for helping keep the principles of liberty alive for the next generation. Good luck with your quiz, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College P.S. For decades, the Constitution has been misunderstood and misrepresented. After you take your and support our free educational efforts, you'll join thousands of Hillsdale friends and supporters who are helping restore and defend liberty. After all, only by reaching and teaching millions of people about our constitutional principles can freedom be secured for the long term. name: Kelly Morrison
subject: re: Trump’s election conspiracy theories
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Morrison for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-em-26 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-em-26]
Donald Trump is back again with false accusations about the 2020 election and foreign interference in our voting systems.
Earlier this month, the president gave a conspiracy-theory-riddled speech about our upcoming midterm elections, claiming once again that there’s widespread fraud and corruption – theories that have been debunked over and over again.
All of this to distract from the reality that he and Republicans are doing nothing to make things better for the American people.
We’ve heard all the lies and spin before, so let’s talk about the facts, instead:
Truth: There’s no proof that the outcome of the 2020 election was altered (because it wasn’t!). Trump promised a trove of declassified documents that “reveal” our broken election system, but major news outlets like the AP, the New York Times, and CNN, among others, confirmed that the documents didn’t offer even a single piece of evidence to back up these claims.
Truth: The SAVE America Act is a voter suppression bill – full stop. Trump’s so-called election security bill he’s demanding Congress pass will actually disenfranchise wide swaths of American voters, including millions of married women who changed their last names.
Truth: This administration is inflicting real pain on our country. From ICE agents wreaking chaos in our communities with zero accountability to millions of additional American children going hungry right now due to Trump's cuts to federal funding – this administration is making us less safe and less healthy.
Truth: Republicans have no plan to address the affordability crisis. Donald Trump ran on affordability, but since returning to office, he’s only made life less affordable. Grocery prices and gas prices are up, and Americans are having to choose between going to the doctor and feeding their families.
Trump and Republicans in Congress seem to think that if they don’t talk about the things keeping us awake at night, we’ll forget the suffering happening all around us. But we won’t forget, and their silence and lack of urgency to fix the issues Americans are dealing with is deafening.
We know that Donald Trump lost the 2020 election fair and square, and it’s painfully clear that he’s afraid of losing again in the midterms. Unfortunately for him, there is no amount of conspiracy theories, no amount of distractions that will help him escape accountability from the American people.
And when we win in November, we will do just that. Together, we can win races up and down the ballot, flip the House to put real checks on this administration, and bring truth back to Congress.
If you’re with me, I could really use your help before the end of the month. A contribution of any amount helps to power my re-election campaign and keep the fight going. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-em-26]

| | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | | Friend, A child who survived the earthquake in Venezuela may have lost everything else.Their parents. Their home. Every relative who might have taken them in. Now they have nowhere to sleep, nothing to eat, and no one left to protect them.**When a child has nowhere to turn, someone else will offer to take her somewhere.** **Too often, that someone is a trafficker, and they know exactly how to make the offer sound like help. **
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=7aeed81bfdef4d4388459069a0920eeb&_e=z8ehzm_s22n-XURgeBPXI3INqywRKxawgKgxBnpl8XNoDNou-nYpJ1uXfRIHIKWC7T86y01BAoLJDIRzCNjwRUTyEGxlv3Z6IjS1BUwTNMEFkWWO19oKN9EXcKxVSkrfBt_n9W3GOnQrtKzoYlZxs7MCiaixGDk1LG4RY8JeMH4aeTCcL-40PteY-_KCjfKO_ASKbDHvppsI5DstNnUIjtn8OEQO1ajuYZQJG85mqGHEHfg8Ovfg5LQunA-Tet0zk_LD4TliZMPf5f5P1Lsmwj2QBC-UPUZRoiu-MUo68ngKUsozCADsmcfIRed2X1mZb2BhBKYrGNrm4OKNgqzkUm5ogsBEgK1_Dm16BrYMr1mo5pB9eH9rNRVCQX5Sdo-QsB77I_5fKyvoY5PFKaexsWXwE8cKLLJtjvEu_ET8lC-qjHzmqXRQ4M-mYoExjQwOXIe7BzmxpF3ILDodVnTGqHA4eQIRa2Czukbm3rEe0qvEb9R17btOdBz0RXc6_cWVcyWbmH7sQWf9JPsVAsxJTR19kc-QTdkuuv77tBqd9ulHlM0RmJ6iwkqLuInPXgjN3pHvC0PT6xvD17dwi1LFDJGfVK6CW7_tMIiRHPBO-POmn4OqdiLvJs051hIfm4-5GuVF2E9i1A11EeIcLqCmJNfLtku0B5YmKCZ7fEOJcWm6z93-cXePDzurl_YkZuBT)

They study the gaps left behind by disaster, and they move quickly, often faster than the systems built to protect children can respond. A shelter without enough staff. A registration process that hasn't caught up. A crowd of frightened families too overwhelmed to watch every child closely. These are the openings traffickers are trained to find.
---

My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film Sound of Freedom, and founded the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** because I believe, without reservation, that every child deserves to be safe, and **none of them are for sale.** Right now, we are working urgently with organizations on the ground in Venezuela. We are helping so that displaced children what they need most: food, water, and a safe place to be found before a trafficker finds them first.
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=7aeed81bfdef4d4388459069a0920eeb&_e=z8ehzm_s22n-XURgeBPXI3INqywRKxawgKgxBnpl8XNoDNou-nYpJ1uXfRIHIKWC7T86y01BAoLJDIRzCNjwRUTyEGxlv3Z6IjS1BUwTNMEFkWWO19oKN9EXcKxVSkrfBt_n9W3GOnQrtKzoYlZxs7MCiaixGDk1LG4RY8JeMH4aeTCcL-40PteY-_KCjfKO_ASKbDHvppsI5DstNnUIjtn8OEQO1ajuYZQJG85mqGHEHfg8Ovfg5LQunA-Tet0zgweb5RzmX8C1-RaSxMVO2w24M0D-13SnJn1d0rCphxvTY20VpEqnt0Jz0Za1H0ZeSwvirHVXw8jEwzPwnru5BsHXarLSTRNMmn7gGqW0lEbCZwwvpd5f0oYSOXPOearfGGGVQ2wEMtC6HXS3qaXsybGNi6h6FpFOB3lxSbl9mp-quGXgIsZTDjeYDsMNrGnfXNEMolx3jKtEr_kj3KMir5SXoeQhyyrsVvFN6qftEGPxuYhH0GyOlUcoA-pxgJSwwZJGsi3oP96Bra6_zCXLw_hOSJrA382D3gNACpXmkxFAAD7W76n3xUWFpscbqKyoyr6jRb3aKezkDkqxKCMt6Vpd-Y3rysl_wKizf5ka4QFKuhSleuITxEBbk0FxeIYP_v_ujb2EsgB3oDEZ3CqaJU_G8kEaE2hT6B9OK3_zKWtuySi-IHY07-Z0JHMiBgfw)

A simple meal or a safe shelter can be the difference between a child staying protected and a child disappearing into a trafficking network. **This work depends on partners we trust deeply, and on donors willing to help fund what those partners cannot do alone. ****Every dollar helps close a gap a trafficker would otherwise use. **We are also funding direct efforts to stop the traffickers themselves, before they can take another child. This means supporting the people working every day to identify and disrupt these networks on the ground. **Often quietly and at real personal risk so fewer children ever go missing in the first place. **

name: Bill Gray
subject: Celebrate 250 years with this historic flag
body:
We should celebrate our great country by remembering the people who built it.

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuKpDAUhp8m7pRc1OjCRTG2MFBdxVyglyGVnNID0UhO7Kbffqihax5glufC98H_v72aV4sBt_liVxiQyPjojYMAt2QzyIZ_gk30gXnJC5KRXLYl16XUxrqM72BqW_ihkaK7dwUMQneN0J3oRbEMzikhgEtx16313nsNstU3L7jq5E10BQ4PHtdSi67uG171uuF1q_re19oqXbOaH7u3GSrcCD2Qi3HfY8CMjqqY5iIMS847MXVicmJyInBHAl8tGAJ5G6ACfzA5_ZuZnG6Q6bNMkai8BzuXLoa4oQ2lXSGhs0xN5JgaOW-69sJlLc-neryOLy-_mGyPvBqKR3LA1LinSDu4jNv8dVrB47EyNcJqMXwtnV13i_PG1PhXbh5y85A_H-KWYctMjd-u5-vl--lsfujy7ffP8plQkQa_f2AISK1mNZ8f-MrFtcj_29v7IP8EAAD__zM8qFc)

| |
Dear Friend,

You and I live in the greatest country in human history--America. And, in 2026, America will turn 250 years old.

That's a quarter-millennium of liberty and self-government-something worth celebrating. **But recent events have led me to wonder: will young people mark this milestone with gratitude? Indifference? Or something worse?**

Hey folks,
We had to dive into one of the strangest political stories unfolding right now: Mitch McConnell's prolonged disappearance from public view and the questions that just keep piling up. We talked about what we actually know, what we don't, why transparency matters, and how this story says something much bigger about accountability in Washington. We also got into Trump's attacks on the press, the White House Correspondents' Dinner, and why so many of our political institutions feel completely disconnected from the people they're supposed to serve.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] We break down the latest "update" on Mitch McConnell and why the new photo raises more questions than it answers.
* [**00:06:24**] We get into the absurdity of the official narrative, the internet theories, and why this story has become impossible to ignore.
* [**00:11:17**] A deeper conversation about aging in public office, dignity, transparency, and where the line should be for elected officials.
* [**00:17:03**] We zoom out to the bigger issue: accountability in Washington, why trust keeps collapsing, and how both parties have enabled a broken system.
* [**00:22:26**] We wrap up with what this means politically, Governor Andy Beshear's next move, and why Democrats need to be willing to play harder when the moment demands it.

This episode goes well beyond Mitch McConnell. It's about what happens when the public stops believing the people running our government because transparency disappears and accountability becomes optional. | | | | Peter, I'm going to be blunt with you, because the stakes are too high for anything less. Please read this entire message. It has taken me over an hour to write this as I collect my thoughts... **The radical Left is attempting a hostile takeover of the great state of Texas -- and they are funding it at a level that should alarm every freedom-loving American who reads these words.** _The Texas Tribune just confirmed it:**my far-left opponent, James Talarico, raised over $30 million in a single quarter**. That's more than triple what we raised._ **This is not an accident.** This is a coordinated, well-funded assault by the Democrat political machine -- the _same machine that has been working systematically_ , state by state, to dismantle the constitutional republic our Founders bled to build. They have targeted Texas because they know what we know _: if they flip this Senate seat, they flip the balance of power in Washington!_ These far-left political fanatics will spend as much as it takes. They'll flood Texas with cash to try to crush us. This is the playbook of people who do not believe in America. It is the playbook of those who hate America. **Remember:** They want wide-open borders. They want far-left control over our children's education. They want to pack the Supreme Court. They want Christianity gone. They want to silence dissent, crush opposition, and fundamentally transform this Nation into an unrecognizable nightmare, with malice towards every patriot who has ever stood and placed their hand over their heart... **They tried to destroy me with witch hunts. They failed.** **They tried to stop us in the primary. They failed.** **They raised $30 million to bury us.** **They will fail again --**_but only if you act right now!_ _**I need you to understand this**_**:** money in politics is not just money. It is air cover. It is television ads running in Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. It is field organizers knocking on doors in precincts across this state. Every dollar they raise that we do not match is a dollar spent convincing Texans to surrender their freedoms to Washington bureaucrats and far-left globalist interests. **We have raised $9 million since April. But we must raise more to stay alive.** The path to victory -- the path to defending President Trump's Senate Majority and holding the line against the radical Left's agenda -- runs directly through your decision in the next few minutes. _Will you stand with us?_

Components from drones that struck the night before on Sunday, March 29, 2026 in El-Obeid, Sudan. Faiz Abubakr / Los Angeles Times via Getty Images.
_Story by_ _Mohamed Wad Al-Sak_
Ahmed Mahmoud's sister, Nafisah, died last month in the city of El-Obeid, another victim of a more than three-year long war raging across Sudan already considered one of the deadliest conflicts for civilians this century.
But like a growing number of Sudanese victims of the war, Mahmoud's sister's death was not the direct result of an airstrike, or gunfire. Instead, she fell victim to the near-total collapse of basic infrastructure in the country as a result of calculated attacks aimed at depriving Sudanese civilians the necessities of life.
The war in Sudan has now killed somewhere between 150,000 to 400,000 people [according](https://substack.com/redirect/6747516f-ed99-4dec-a14c-b4917986de77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to outside analysts, with people dying from a combination of direct violence, hunger, and lack of access to healthcare.
In June, the 21-year-old Nafisah suddenly fell faint and needed urgent hospital care; she had been managing the impact of an under-treated blood clot in her left leg since 2024. With El-Obeid under constant drone attack and bombardment conducted by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), receiving prompt medical care for basic conditions was nearly impossible.
"We called the ambulance and waited a long time for any tuk-tuk or private car. Then we were told that movement was difficult because of the conditions and the fuel shortage," Mahmoud said. Blood clots can be life-threatening without immediate medical treatment. "After that we started looking for any car or way to move her. But time kept passing, and her condition kept getting worse."
When they finally did reach the hospital, the facility was facing resource and personnel strains due to the war and overwhelmed with patients. "When we arrived we found the doctors trying to help everyone, but the pressure was immense and resources were limited. It was clear they were working under extremely difficult conditions," he said.
His sister died several hours after arriving at the hospital. Her death still haunts her family members, who believe that the delay in arriving at the facility and receiving treatment contributed to her death.
"After she died, I kept thinking: if the ambulance had arrived faster, or if the services hadn't broken down, maybe my sister would still be with us," Mahmoud said. "People think war only kills those struck by shells. But the truth is it also kills when it prevents a patient from reaching treatment. My sister was one of them."

## **War on Infrastructure**
The crisis that has overtaken hospitals and other infrastructure in El-Obeid is the product of a calculated military campaign waged by the RSF that has directly targeted civilian infrastructure and imposed a de facto siege.
In recent months, the RSF, which receives arms and other support from the United Arab Emirates, has begun using bombardment by foreign-supplied drones to destroy critical infrastructure, attack supply lines, and force the capitulation of the city's population.
El-Obeid itself remains under the control of the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF). Its 5th Infantry Division is headquartered in the city, which serves as the army's main operational base in North Kordofan, after being pushed out of the Sudanese capital of Khartoum, and falling back toward its western strongholds in Darfur last year, the group no longer has the manpower or heavy equipment to mount a direct ground assault and seize the city outright.
Lacking the ability to launch a direct assault, the RSF has reverted to besieging the entire city--cutting supply lines into El-Obeid and striking infrastructure with drones on a regular basis. El-Obeid has experienced a spike in aerial attacks since mid-June, according to the [global monitor group Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED](https://substack.com/redirect/98c10712-5088-4eea-9632-b79b5258faf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
Those findings are echoed by local residents who say that drone attacks by the RSF have intensified against the city, targeting fuel and water infrastructure while making many roadways too dangerous to cross. For [five consecutive days](https://substack.com/redirect/747ac7e9-0bd1-478b-8367-6c7f5fa9271d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the middle of this month, strikes hit fuel stations in El-Obeid. On June 19, a [strike](https://substack.com/redirect/4b6caead-9aa9-49e1-9b67-51cf5c089cc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the main power transformer cut off electricity entirely.
The price of food and fuel is skyrocketing as supplies disappear, while families have resorted to digging wells in a desperate attempt to access water of dubious safety. Nour al-Din Hajj al-Lain, 37, a transport worker in El-Obeid, said that in the wake of the fuel station attacks, fuel prices have reached approximately $30 per gallon with passenger fares rising by up to 2,000 pounds. "Many people are now walking to work," he said. "El-Obeid is a principal transit point--when transport here is disrupted, the impact extends across a wide area well beyond the city itself."
Adam Hamid, who has been working in El-Obeid's main market for about 15 years, said most residents continue their daily lives despite mounting anxiety, but that uncertainty and insecurity has already altered economic behavior. Before the drone attacks made daily life in the city unsafe, the market was much busier, Hamid said. His small shop, which sells household basics, used to receive around 50-70 customers a day. That average has dropped to less than half--dipping further on days following attacks, or when there are reports of possible new strikes.
"Most customers now focus only on essential goods such as food and basic necessities, while postponing non-essential purchases or larger expenses," he explained. Traders are similarly cautious and have stopped buying large quantities of goods or are reducing their operations. On June 24 members of Congress [urged](https://substack.com/redirect/3e55c3f4-b981-41be-9168-190f006ad1c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the State Department to secure an agreement to lift the siege, which it said the RSF and its allies have used to "collectively punish civilians and maximize death and destruction."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/71ecc571-0b8d-438e-869e-777bbd4b75e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A man stands in a hole filled with drone components on Sunday, March 29, 2026 in El Obeid, Sudan. Faiz Abubakr / Los Angeles Times via Getty Images.
## **Healthcare Disruptions**
Emergency first responders in El-Obeid today describe a nightmarish situation in which shortages of fuel have left them unable to reach civilians in distress, while drone attacks on major roads make it treacherous for ambulances to travel even when fuel is available.
"Before, we used to move the moment we got a call. Now the first question we ask is: is the road safe?" said an ambulance driver at a health facility in the city, who asked not to be named for security reasons. "Often we delay or take longer routes to avoid areas that might be targeted [by airstrikes], which means the patient waits longer before help arrives."
For patients with hemorrhaging or blood clots--like the sister of Ahmed Mahmoud--that delay can mean the difference between life and death.
Abdelmajeed Mohammed, a neurosurgeon in El-Obeid, said that the escalation of attacks has transformed how the city's referral hospitals operate. "In a single minute, 50 patients can come in, and life practically stops with the shelling," said Mohammed.
Drone strikes, he added, have paralyzed every step of the medical system.
"Ambulances struggle to move because of fuel shortages and security risks, medical staff are delayed getting to the hospital, and medical supplies are disrupted," he said. "And if the power goes out or the generator fuel runs dry, vital equipment--monitors, oxygen, operating rooms, dialysis machines--all stop. That's why we say life inside the hospital nearly comes to a halt."
The strikes on fuel stations have also further crippled hospitals, which rely on them to operate generators amid nationwide blackouts and strikes on electrical power stations.
"Two days ago we were forced to suspend some emergency admissions because of a power outage, and before that, surgeries were postponed because generator fuel wasn't available," he said. "Fuel is the lifeline of the hospital for us. Patients who need oxygen depend on machines that don't work without electricity, and even the machines that read vital signs don't work without electricity and fuel. And if you can't see the vital signs, you can't treat the patient."
El-Obeid's Al-Jameeh Dialysis Center is one of the last medical centers offering kidney dialysis in western Sudan after war shut down services across the area. But now, it too is teetering.
Ayman Abdulrahman, one of the center's medical staff, said machines are breaking down at a rapid clip because of the relentless flow of patients. At the moment, all they can do is scale back services. "In the past we used to give the patient two full sessions, but with the pressure and the machine shortage we were forced to cut the session length so we could give other patients a chance too."
A similar wave of strikes [in June 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/e7d32645-bc45-488f-8d73-a1cd8d9d10f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) wreaked havoc on the dialysis unit, with at least 12 patients dying as a result. So far there are no officially documented figures on how many deaths have resulted at the center from the latest strikes.
"The work day now starts with the question: do we have electricity? Is there enough fuel to run the generator?" said Esraa Awad, a doctor at the dialysis center and its former director. "A patient hooked up to a dialysis machine can't simply have their session stopped because of shelling or a power cut. Any sudden interruption puts us in front of real medical risks."
Awad explained the fuel crisis extends beyond generators to patient transport and the arrival of staff and supplies: "Dialysis isn't just a machine, it's an interconnected chain. If the fuel or electricity is cut, or a patient or supplies can't get through, the whole link collapses--and the patient is the first to pay the price."
After the RSF stepped up its strikes on fuel-stations in June, it cut even deeper into critical energy supplies for the city's hospitals, said an emergency room nurse at Al-Daman Hospital, who asked not to be named for her personal safety. "We now start every shift not knowing whether the power will hold, or whether there's enough fuel to run the generator until the end of the day," she said. "These are questions that weren't part of our job before the war."
## **Drone Warfare**
In addition to the impact on civilians, the RSF strikes on infrastructure are also changing the balance of the war around El-Obeid. A member of the Joint Forces, an armed group aligned with the SAF, told Drop Site on condition of anonymity that the military was having difficulties moving troops and supplies as a result of RSF attacks on fuel stations and roads in the area.
The region now being contested by the two sides has become vital to the larger war. The area under siege separates the army-controlled east of Sudan from the RSF-controlled west. That makes it the main corridor through which the warring parties move troops, weapons, fuel, and supplies.
For both sides, drones have become an important tool for combat, as well as a means to punish and pressure the civilian population. In the first four months of 2026, armed drones caused more than 80% of civilian deaths, killing at least 880 people nationwide, with the Kordofan and Darfur regions hardest hit, the UN [said](https://substack.com/redirect/d2305963-3e55-4353-875a-ae69369ee75c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in May.
The drones themselves come from [outside Sudan](https://substack.com/redirect/c810c093-043c-4950-98de-06012ec3e559?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). According to [international investigations](https://substack.com/redirect/c810c093-043c-4950-98de-06012ec3e559?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the RSF's fleet--including [Chinese-made](https://substack.com/redirect/f2e066d9-9e3f-4f5a-8e0e-80ec34f5aaae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) CH-95 and Wing Loong II drones--reaches the battlefield through a UAE-linked supply network routed through Chad and Libya.
The SAF's drones, including [Iranian Mohajer-6](https://substack.com/redirect/4d87bd44-f179-460a-a87f-b8be89fac7ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Ababil-3 models and Turkish Bayraktar TB2 and Akinci aircraft, [reportedly arrive](https://substack.com/redirect/1671c942-a9d7-4ec9-b084-aa8c3c36edf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the support of Egypt, which has provided the army with aircraft, ammunition, and military coordination throughout the war.
The current wave of attacks on El-Obeid accelerated after the historic capital of the massive Darfur region, El-Fasher, fell in October 2025--an event that was also followed by a [horrific massacre](https://substack.com/redirect/a3a6995d-6bd9-4367-9e2c-311f8e169875?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the city according to local witnesses and international monitors.
On January 4, RSF drones hit El-Obeid's [city's thermal power plant](https://substack.com/redirect/d79aeaf8-39b7-4b79-a32d-44a04ef417fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The attack came as part of a wider wave that also struck the Merowe Dam and Kenana airbase in the city. On January 30, roughly 20 RSF drones [struck government buildings ](https://substack.com/redirect/193a2d14-1ebf-442b-a670-ae0d44d8b796?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in a rare daytime attack.
The UN has said that drone attacks are now expanding beyond Kordofan and Darfur into the regions of Blue Nile, White Nile, and Khartoum itself. A strike on Khartoum International Airport [on May 4](https://substack.com/redirect/87757315-9a11-4931-bcb8-6f60aa40196f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) grounded all flights, raising fears that hostilities could return to the capital after a period of relative calm.
## **" Total Collapse of Everything"**
Civilians in El-Obeid are struggling to maintain the surviving infrastructure in the city. A pediatrician at El-Obeid Teaching Hospital described the situation as a "total collapse of everything," with the breakdown of supply chains and power infrastructure depriving children of life-saving interventions. He said he's seen numerous cases where children have died because of the indirect impacts of airstrikes.
"The child needs blood, and we don't have any. He needs oxygen, but the generator has stopped. He needs to be transferred to a higher-level hospital, but no ambulance dares take the road," said the doctor, who asked to be identified by the initials MT to protect his safety. "The drone didn't strike this child directly. But it killed him."
The dire conditions are compounded by the rising number of displaced people arriving from other regions as refugees. "El-Obeid is hosting growing numbers of displaced people, while at the same time its own residents are suffering from repeated attacks on their livelihoods, infrastructure, and basic services," said Majdi al-Naeem of the Sudan Human Rights Monitor.
Al-Naeem said the attacks on infrastructure do not, in his view, serve any clear military objective, but instead impose direct burdens on the civilian population. "In my assessment, these attacks don't serve a military purpose so much as they affect civilians' lives, and targeting civilian objects is prohibited under international humanitarian law," he said.
On Monday, the Sudanese army and allied groups [recaptured](https://substack.com/redirect/603d77ad-6f0e-432d-9071-3c927d8948ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Bara, Al-Baraka, Um Sayala, Jabrat Al-Sheikh, and other areas on Sunday after heavy clashes with the RSF, according to military officials cited by Sudan Tribune. Officials said 73 RSF vehicles were destroyed, others seized, and numerous fighters killed. The advance opens a new supply corridor to El-Obeid, strengthening its eastern defenses.
For the past few weeks, talk has been spreading of a possible RSF offensive once the city and its defenders have been sufficiently weakened by the siege. The SAF reclaiming the highway into El-Obeid will likely disrupt the RSF's momentum toward El-Obeid, restricting the movement of fighters, supplies, and reinforcements.
Zahra Nurain, a mother of five living in the Karima neighborhood in the city's northeast, said the talk of a potential large-scale battle has been a daily source of anxiety but has not pushed her toward leaving--a reflection of the limited choices available after more than three years of war.
"We hear the news and rumors every day, and sometimes we follow the sounds of aircraft and explosions. But where would we go?" she said. "El-Obeid has become a refuge for many people during this war. We hope it does not become another battlefield."

After the RSF stepped up its strikes on fuel-stations in June, it cut even deeper into critical energy supplies for the city's hospitals, said an emergency room nurse at Al-Daman Hospital, who asked not to be named for her personal safety. "We now start every shift not knowing whether the power will hold, or whether there's enough fuel to run the generator until the end of the day," she said. "These are questions that weren't part of our job before the war." Drone Warfare In addition to the impact on civilians, the RSF strikes on infrastructure are also changing the balance of the war around El-Obeid. A member of the Joint Forces, an armed group aligned with the SAF, told Drop Site on condition of anonymity that the military was having difficulties moving troops and supplies as a result of RSF attacks on fuel stations and roads in the area. The region now being contested by the two sides has become vital to the larger war. The area under siege separates the army-controlled east of Sudan from the RSF-controlled west. That makes it the main corridor through which the warring parties move troops, weapons, fuel, and supplies. For both sides, drones have become an important tool for combat, as well as a means to punish and pressure the civilian population. In the first four months of 2026, armed drones caused more than 80% of civilian deaths, killing at least 880 people nationwide, with the Kordofan and Darfur regions hardest hit, the UN in May. The drones themselves come from . According to , the RSF's fleet--including CH-95 and Wing Loong II drones--reaches the battlefield through a UAE-linked supply network routed through Chad and Libya. The SAF's drones, including and Ababil-3 models and Turkish Bayraktar TB2 and Akinci aircraft, with the support of Egypt, which has provided the army with aircraft, ammunition, and military coordination throughout the war. The current wave of attacks on El-Obeid accelerated after the historic capital of the massive Darfur region, El-Fasher, fell in October 2025--an event that was also followed by a in the city according to local witnesses and international monitors. On January 4, RSF drones hit El-Obeid's . The attack came as part of a wider wave that also struck the Merowe Dam and Kenana airbase in the city. On January 30, roughly 20 RSF drones a rare daytime attack. The UN has said that drone attacks are now expanding beyond Kordofan and Darfur into the regions of Blue Nile, White Nile, and Khartoum itself. A strike on Khartoum International Airport grounded all flights, raising fears that hostilities could return to the capital after a period of relative calm. " Total Collapse of Everything" Civilians in El-Obeid are struggling to maintain the surviving infrastructure in the city. A pediatrician at El-Obeid Teaching Hospital described the situation as a "total collapse of everything," with the breakdown of supply chains and power infrastructure depriving children of life-saving interventions. He said he's seen numerous cases where children have died because of the indirect impacts of airstrikes. "The child needs blood, and we don't have any. He needs oxygen, but the generator has stopped. He needs to be transferred to a higher-level hospital, but no ambulance dares take the road," said the doctor, who asked to be identified by the initials MT to protect his safety. "The drone didn't strike this child directly. But it killed him." The dire conditions are compounded by the rising number of displaced people arriving from other regions as refugees. "El-Obeid is hosting growing numbers of displaced people, while at the same time its own residents are suffering from repeated attacks on their livelihoods, infrastructure, and basic services," said Majdi al-Naeem of the Sudan Human Rights Monitor. Al-Naeem said the attacks on infrastructure do not, in his view, serve any clear military objective, but instead impose direct burdens on the civilian population. "In my assessment, these attacks don't serve a military purpose so much as they affect civilians' lives, and targeting civilian objects is prohibited under international humanitarian law," he said. On Monday, the Sudanese army and allied groups Bara, Al-Baraka, Um Sayala, Jabrat Al-Sheikh, and other areas on Sunday after heavy clashes with the RSF, according to military officials cited by Sudan Tribune. Officials said 73 RSF vehicles were destroyed, others seized, and numerous fighters killed. The advance opens a new supply corridor to El-Obeid, strengthening its eastern defenses. For the past few weeks, talk has been spreading of a possible RSF offensive once the city and its defenders have been sufficiently weakened by the siege. The SAF reclaiming the highway into El-Obeid will likely disrupt the RSF's momentum toward El-Obeid, restricting the movement of fighters, supplies, and reinforcements. Zahra Nurain, a mother of five living in the Karima neighborhood in the city's northeast, said the talk of a potential large-scale battle has been a daily source of anxiety but has not pushed her toward leaving--a reflection of the limited choices available after more than three years of war. "We hear the news and rumors every day, and sometimes we follow the sounds of aircraft and explosions. But where would we go?" she said. "El-Obeid has become a refuge for many people during this war. We hope it does not become another battlefield." Mohamed Wad Al-Sak is a Sudanese freelance journalist and multimedia producer covering conflict, displacement, and human rights across Sudan and East Africa. We've agreed that to pull off everything we have planned, we need to raise another $12,000 in online grassroots contributions before July is over.

Peter, I know my team and I email you a lot to share updates about our campaign.
But today’s message is a little bit different, and I wanted to reach out to you directly.
Right now, we are officially 14 weeks away from Election Day. So I’m reaching out to a smaller group of people like you, folks who have yet to make a donation since our primary win back in March.
**Today, I’m specifically emailing you to ask for a _big_ favor.** With Greg Abbott and his corporate mega-donors flooding Texas with millions upon millions to make sure we don’t win this November, I’m wondering if you have my back.

According to our records, you haven’t had the opportunity to donate since our primary win on March 3rd. Every donation, even if it’s a dollar, makes a _huge_ difference as we enter the last 14-week sprint to defeat Greg Abbott, and I’m relying on you to step up right now.
None of this would have been possible without you, Peter. Whether it’s donating to emails like this, knocking on doors, showing up to our town halls — I appreciate everything you’ve done for this campaign.
