[](https://substack.com/redirect/7f2ee6c7-3ccf-4be7-a1b2-eebc2fce83d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/7f2ee6c7-3ccf-4be7-a1b2-eebc2fce83d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
When I decided to attend a Democratic Socialist fundraising party in NYC on Saturday I had no idea I was going to see the far-left's secret plan to interfere with ICE enforcement first hand, presented to us via a Power Point slideshow.
My producer and I RSVPed for the event a few days beforehand, which was listed on the DSA's website and newsletter for a minimum ticket price of $20.
We drove out to Starr Barr in Brooklyn around 7:30 with good intentions to meet and speak with real socialists - the people who got Mayor Zohran Mamdani elected and helped a slew of other socialist candidates win their primaries in recent weeks.
Who were these people? How do they socialize with each other? Would they be okay with a polite conservative reporter crashing their party?
## Support fearless independent journalism by becoming a paid subscriber:
[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/ed058422-0aab-4de5-ada1-505ddfa2b1a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We parked on the grimy street, covered in trash and graffiti and full of young hipsters with piercings, tattoos, and smoking cigarettes. As we approached the venue I started to think to myself: "Why did I wear a suit and tie to this?"
My plan was to be open and forthcoming about who I was, a conservative editor of The Capitalist Magazine on Substack looking to observe the DSA in their natural habitat. But if I'm the only guy in a suit in a sea of baggy band t-shirts and ripped jeans then I'm already going to stand out in a bad way.
The suit signals productivity, ambition, and the professional class of people antithetical to the socialist worldview. And it was like fucking 95 degrees and very humid. I realized I was a moron and didn't think this all the way through, but I was already committed to my first mistake of the evening.
We walked right in, no problem. Showed our digital tickets, awkwardly nodded to the Hot Topic employees at the front door and beelined to the bar for a Miller Light and a Jameson on the rocks for my producer.
They only had obscure hipster craft beers. Should have guessed.
There was only about 30 people in the whole place when we arrived, and we were about 45 mins late. An empty dance floor and a pool table covered in DSA literature and pins across from the bar. Not the packed venue of young socialists I was expecting, but not completely dead either.
I started talking to a nice bald man who passed by the bar. He was a healthcare worker and started talking my ear off about how socialized healthcare should be a no-brainer here in New York. He said every other civilized country has it, it's great and other countries laugh at Americans because of our healthcare system, etc. He made some admittedly strong points, focussing on the logistics of implementation rather than ideological slop. I wasn't completely convinced, and the American healthcare system is not my area of expertise, so we parted cordially with a handshake.
The room filled up a bit more before everyone was told to be quiet for a big speech. Marina Weiss, the event organizer and the person who would soon kick me out of the party, got on stage and grabbed the mic.
Fortunately, the first thing she said was that she goes by she/her pronouns, something I could tell the whole room, including myself, was relieved to confirm, otherwise how would we know she's a woman?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7f2ee6c7-3ccf-4be7-a1b2-eebc2fce83d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hidden footage of DSA anti-ICE slideshow
This is when I could tell we weren't supposed to be here and that they did not want press or outsiders present. She explicitly said as much, acknowledging that it was an "unvetted room" yet continued to explain how community members could text a hotline when they spot ICE agents around the city and activists would immediately be mobilized to the scene to interfere with ICE's "kidnapping."
I've covered **[anti-ICE protests in NYC](https://substack.com/redirect/effe2f00-501f-4db2-a255-36bab312ef89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** where activists stand in the way of ICE agents, block their cars, drag trash cans out into the streets to disrupt and impede law enforcement, and now I was witnessing how they know where to be and who is involved in organizing all of this chaos.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/effe2f00-501f-4db2-a255-36bab312ef89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**[The video embedded at the top of this article](https://substack.com/redirect/7f2ee6c7-3ccf-4be7-a1b2-eebc2fce83d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** shows the highlights of the nearly 30 minute speech. Watch her explain it for yourself, it's surprisingly simple how they do it.
After her speech, someone I was speaking with earlier introduced me to Marina. I shook her hand and introduced myself as the editor of The Capitalist and that I was eager to learn about how the DSA organizes and speak with attendees about their beliefs, etc.
This was a big mistake.
She looked me in the eye and demanded I follow her and she started toward the front door. I knew where this was going. But I proceeded with the hope I could talk to her more before she deported me from her event.
"Uh oh, I hope I'm not in trouble," I said.
"You're not in too much trouble," she responded, then walking over to the bouncer at the front door and commanding him not to let me back inside.
"Why can't I go back in?" I asked.
"What are your feelings about abolishing ICE?" she asked, I guess giving me one more chance to conform to her ideological purity test before I was banished.
"Well, I agree with you that ICE is not perfect, but I also think that there has to be some enforcement of immigration law. So, if you support abolishing ICE, what would take its place?" I asked her.
She didn't even answer. She told the bouncer again to not let me back in and stormed back inside.
In ICE-like fashion, she deported me from the party without any due process. But was I entitled to due process as an outsider and a non-DSA aligned alien? Probably not. So she was in the right. I was a deportable target, subject to lawful removal from the private event, and I respected that.
## Support fearless independent journalism by becoming a paid subscriber:
[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/ed058422-0aab-4de5-ada1-505ddfa2b1a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I apologized the bouncer, assuring him I did not want to cause any trouble for him and would finish my drink outside. He laughed and said he agreed with me and the premise of my question: How are we going to enforce immigration law without ICE or another federal law enforcement body assigned to do so?
He was a chill dude just tryin to keep his job and I had absolutely no quarrel with him. But luckily the party came outside to me and my producer who was smoking like a chimney with a group of shaggy leftists on the sidewalk.
We spent the rest of the night debating DSA members about deportations, Mamdani's free services proposals, free markets vs central planning and more, and it was a lot of fun. It took me back to my college days of engaging in political debates as a proxy for socializing. I made a lot of friends and enemies and it primed me for what we are up against today.
There are cool people in almost every group, including radical political movements. I try not to demonize anyone before getting a chance to meet them and hear them out. It's clear that the DSA is extremely motivated and emboldened by their recent primary wins and I had a sense that they felt like their nationwide victory was not only plausible but inevitable.
I hope they are wrong. As nice as some of them were, their ideas are not new, they have come to fruition by way of young passionate revolutionaries in other countries who stopped at nothing to achieve their utopian goals at the cost of millions of lives and wide scale poverty.
Even after bloody socialist revolutions pan out, the systems that are implemented are objectively dysfunctional and yield unspeakable suffering. Democratic Socialism isn't just affordable housing and healthcare, it's a broad and intense rebuke of the western capitalist superstructure and a rejection of American traditionalism. They are not fooling me, or really anyone on the right with their ploy to appear moderate. The movement is an all-or-nothing heist of the tenets of American civilization, aka everything conservatives are trying to conserve.
Let's not whine and complain like they do when they call us fascists, lets defeat their politics in the marketplace of ideas and make America's choice very clear between a system that works and a system that cannibalizes itself every single time.
I look forward to attending more DSA events in the future as a respectful observer, though I don't expect to be on their VIP list any time soon.

subject: Let's make the final week count!
body:
| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/elizabethforvirginia/lets-make-the-final-week-count?e=2f83c585b2)
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | | |
# One Week Away
---
| |
## _Join us on the campaign trail to keep the momentum going_
---
| | **Dear Peter,**
**I know it’s hard to believe, but Election Day is one week from tomorrow! With the end in sight, I wanted to take a moment to thank you from the bottom of my heart for believing in me, this movement, and in a better future for all of us.**
**We’ll be traversing the community turnout out every last voters for these final few days. On Wednesday, I’ll be participating in a**[**protest outside Rob Wittman’s Yorktown office**](https://us.list-manage.com/4WSY0kxkBdE?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**from 10:30-11:30.**
**On Thursday, I’ll be joining the**[**Hanover Dems for a night of “Drinking Liberally”**](https://us.list-manage.com/MEbDrX2iXGr?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**—featuring great drinks, food, and conversations at Mexico Restaurant in Mechanicsville from 6:30pm-8:30pm.**
**On Friday, we are throwing a an**[**Election Weekend Kickoff Party**](https://us.list-manage.com/E7MaU6i1NwQ?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**from 6-8pm at McCormick’s Big Whisky Grill in Henrico. Tickets start at $30, but volunteers get in for free!**
**On Saturday, we’ll be at the**[**Mathews Democrats Annual Crab Steam**](https://us.list-manage.com/ScWCclGVuBL?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**. This will take place from 5p-7pm on Saturday, August 1st, at Piankatank Ruritan Club. This is a great opportunity to share in a special summer tradition during the final few days of the campaign.**
**Finally, I am hosting a**[**watch party on Election Night at my house**](https://us.list-manage.com/66ct7uyYJiJ?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**, and I am personally inviting you to join me as we celebrate the incredible work this campaign has done over the past nine months. You can RSVP for that—and all remaining campaign events—by clicking below:**
* [Tuesday Phone Bank (Online)—Tuesday, July 28th, 5:30pm-6:30pm](https://us.list-manage.com/rBREsL6CbJI?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Wittman Wednesday Protest, Yorktown—Wednesday, July 29th, 10:30am-11:30am](https://us.list-manage.com/k7aLOCfiMDp?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Thursday Phone Bank (Online)—Thursday, July 30th, 6:45pm-8:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/2YvVhSKz0OC?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Drinking Liberally with Hanover Dems—Thursday, July 30th, 6:30pm-8:30pm](https://us.list-manage.com/G0oAv6NJ0eH?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Election Weekend Kickoff Party—Friday, July 31st, 6:00pm-8:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/KD8wZluAqms?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Mathews Dems Annual Crab Steam—Saturday, August 1st, 5:00pm-7:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/13xVcCYdwib?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Sunday Phone Bank (Online)—Sunday, August 2nd, 2:00pm-4:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/NyyZTIFB3JT?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Election Night Watch Party—Tuesday, August 4th, 6:30pm-10:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/6xcqtDHKIdZ?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)

**Every door you knocked, every phone call you made, every dollar you donated, and every text you sent out helped us get to this point. I can’t thank you enough. Now let’s finish the job together.**
**—Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs**

body:
| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
| | Peter, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=8a4a0d0efc8141f8af8d84c81ffb06b0&_e=uzwIud66CTT40ohL_EykjSGr22aEQKb-RXU4YyNzSfyhvTdZk7HYxmdjQ-9L57GS8Xr2WzYOpJdRqtKGktremNVwS2GBeVeI1nrygtAgmiCbT5n2ry9bVsgWxsJ3yu3PZ29PYOj0IjCuurUnYUoan7ngTM0Y2hdi-qe91oXLncEr91l8TfUBvkpJOzoIjq4lot-ZPudBVc2cNzIzNsJwXN8RbopM3PzwyxDRgt92wH-wO98vP93HYlS4u2p7k-pEXWyFHaC5hluFkg_dmbdRIBafafPLZF0yu-2eIZNpbcvgiRYr0Bkfw5HTS268NKZuY5clq7ONiGIPP4R-BfLDiNvFYvSG5jeqbaUWjHvjh7Y-A_BYO9g4Wt0s_xmVIICkhC6TuADDaWz-x2eXv-Z_jf_NCPPJ4gbB-gsCTwDaqjiZyq9S37B7LGlVltb4Yxv23uKsIeGaZJ4eDilzweNVZ7e5ZflSOaO2Q1GROiW4APC64jQJzl2xyrNDsL0MVmWN4TANhdPKnGXZWI-4NfX5AsX6iNVUIe3mTfrgxYXCfwzN8biZC_HxLsPq-9fOBzdTkXqw4OA8_KQE0TIttPok7dtiX0V-OqFQJ-elEo20VgPej8ltxfPkTxw1IOx0aHMJEFKFbTbvqCdEwvAJNKFpuZklsRrm_xDcns567qmhsbrk0Tv6EuTMzzTeiq6ZLP-q3_plfGkMATABOc2sdjqpV9XrjmTEWs2vDmNLbzpFG9E%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $125, or anything higher or lower please send in your sponsorship gift in the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.” Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America, Kirk Cameron | | | BRAVE For Good 100 I-45 N 260Conroe, TX 77301 | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com

---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136101254/636351247/1793776944?refcode=emm_ffa_20260727_ReadingList_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODU1YTI3My1mNjg5LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yRoEdWdmna3sxwRkZmDi0_kSb8IOlemtmh8vmxvYUuE=&emci=276cf427-3889-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=8855a273-f689-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=1037277)

| | Maybe this time of year makes you nostalgic for summer reading challenges. Maybe this season gives you a little more time to settle in with a good book. Maybe you want to explore how our democracy got into its current state, and connect with other voting rights supporters about how we chart a new path forward. If you nodded along to any of those sentences, then we’ve got just the summer reading list for you. **We’re excited to introduce the Fair Fight Action Book Club: a space to learn, connect, and share how our elections actually work and who they’re built to work for.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136101256/636351253/-1205073758?refcode=emm_ffa_20260727_ReadingList_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODU1YTI3My1mNjg5LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yRoEdWdmna3sxwRkZmDi0_kSb8IOlemtmh8vmxvYUuE=&emci=276cf427-3889-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=8855a273-f689-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=1037277) Here are two ways to join: [Subscribe to our Broadcast Channel on Instagram](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136101259/636351256/-467925465?refcode=emm_ffa_20260727_ReadingList_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODU1YTI3My1mNjg5LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yRoEdWdmna3sxwRkZmDi0_kSb8IOlemtmh8vmxvYUuE=&emci=276cf427-3889-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=8855a273-f689-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=1037277) or [follow us for deep dives on our Substack.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136101261/636351258/701191476?refcode=emm_ffa_20260727_ReadingList_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODU1YTI3My1mNjg5LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yRoEdWdmna3sxwRkZmDi0_kSb8IOlemtmh8vmxvYUuE=&emci=276cf427-3889-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=8855a273-f689-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=1037277) Over the next several weeks, we’ll host video interviews with the authors, share key insights, and discuss how the lessons apply to our current work. This summer, we’re digging into three books about who really holds power at the ballot box:
1. _Minority Rule: The Right-Wing Attack on the Will of the People — And the Fight to Resist It by Ari Berman._
2. _One Person, No Vote: How Voter Suppression Is Destroying Our Democracy by Dr. Carol Anderson._

Just days ago, independent journalist **Nick Shirley** walked into the California State Capitol with a camera and confronted the Democrat lawmakers who are trying to silence him. Most of them scattered. The few who stayed had no real answers. _Why the panic?_ Because California Democrats are fast-tracking **AB 2624** -- already being called the **" Stop Nick Shirley Act."** This bill would make it a **crime** for citizen journalists like Nick to film or post videos of publicly funded facilities -- exactly the kind of on-the-ground investigative work Nick has been doing in California and Minnesota. If this bill passes, Nick's ability to expose taxpayer fraud in government programs could be severely crippled -- or even criminalized -- with fines up to $10,000 and forced content removal. Think about what that means:
---
* Nick's explosive Minnesota daycare fraud investigation that forced Congress to take notice?
* His on-the-ground reporting in California exposing waste and abuse in government programs?
* Future investigations into hospice fraud, voter roll issues, or any other taxpayer-funded facility?

---

The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they're trying to criminalize investigative journalism. They had no good answer. **That 's why Lincoln Media Foundation exists -- and why we're asking for your help again today.** LMF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that **directly funds** independent journalists like Nick Shirley. clean_body: They’re trying to silence him California Democrats are fast-tracking a bill called the "Stop Nick Shirley Act" that threatens everything Nick and LMF are doing. | | | | | | | Friend, Just days ago, independent journalist Nick Shirley walked into the California State Capitol with a camera and confronted the Democrat lawmakers who are trying to silence him. Most of them scattered. The few who stayed had no real answers. Why the panic? Because California Democrats are fast-tracking AB 2624 -- already being called the " Stop Nick Shirley Act." This bill would make it a crime for citizen journalists like Nick to film or post videos of publicly funded facilities -- exactly the kind of on-the-ground investigative work Nick has been doing in California and Minnesota. If this bill passes, Nick's ability to expose taxpayer fraud in government programs could be severely crippled -- or even criminalized -- with fines up to $10,000 and forced content removal. Think about what that means: Nick's explosive Minnesota daycare fraud investigation that forced Congress to take notice? His on-the-ground reporting in California exposing waste and abuse in government programs? Future investigations into hospice fraud, voter roll issues, or any other taxpayer-funded facility? All of it could be criminalized under this new law. The message from Sacramento Democrats is crystal clear: " Stop exposing the fraud... **or we 'll make sure you can't." And the ultimate irony? The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they're trying to criminalize investigative journalism. They had no good answer. That 's why Lincoln Media Foundation exists -- and why we're asking for your help again today. LMF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that directly funds independent journalists like Nick Shirley. We cover the real costs of his work -- travel, filming, editing, distribution, and security -- so he can keep investigating stories the mainstream media refuses to touch. Right now, your tax-deductible donation to LMF will go toward supporting Nick Shirley and protecting his ability to continue this critical work in the face of this new threat. Under the banner of Trump's expanded "war on drugs," U.S. forces have reportedly been bombing fishing boats off the coast of Ecuador. body:
My name is Troy Jackson, and I’m a fifth-generation logger from Allagash.
|

---
Peter, my name is Troy Jackson, and I’m a fifth-generation logger from Allagash. And with your help, we’re going to send Susan Collins packing and flip this critical Senate seat for Democrats.
**[_Can you chip in $5 split between my campaign and Roy Cooper to help power my campaign through November and flip this seat? >>_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/17578?amount=5&t=7&akid=2364%2E124072%2Eknkcjo)**

1\. I’m starting this campaign from the ground floor with **99 days to go** until Election Day.
2\. Susan Collins and her allies have dedicated **$10 million to prop her up** , and pundits are saying Donald Trump’s MAGA dark money donors could spend up to **$200 million to defeat me**.
3\. Susan Collins has voted with Donald Trump 96% of the time... **she’s refused to stand up for working Mainers** at every turn. 4\. Experts predict the Senate could come down to the closest of margins, with **Maine being the must-win seat** to take back our majority.
5\. My team asked me to reach out to Democrats like you to prove to Susan Collins and the GOP machine that **this people-powered movement has what it takes to fight back and win this seat.**
**[_So, I’m humbly asking you again. Can you chip in just $5 today split between my campaign and Roy Cooper, to defeat Susan Collins and flip this seat to take back our Senate Majority? >>_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/17578?amount=5&t=9&akid=2364%2E124072%2Eknkcjo)**

name: David Hogg
subject: This is why I walked away
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
I saw the writing on the wall.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260727-1&t=1&akid=3779%2E587540%2ETjlo2Y)
I’m sure you’ve heard the news, Peter.
DNC Chair, Ken Martin, is busy throwing phones at staffers, forcing officers to sign NDAs in order to see the budget, and mortgaging the DNC’s headquarters just to keep the lights on.
One thing is clear: **The establishment is in complete disarray.**
When I was Vice Chair, I saw the writing on the wall. I saw firsthand that the establishment wasn’t willing to do what it takes to restore trust in our party and win. It’s why I walked away.
And now the absolute chaos inside the DNC is undeniable. _Even James Carville, who has not historically been my biggest fan, has suggested that I step in as chair and fix this mess._
**Let me be clear: we’re in a critical, must win election year.** This is the moment to be aggressively building grassroots infrastructure, mobilizing voters, and supporting leaders who will break the GOP’s grip on power and give us a real fighting chance in 2028.
**Instead, Ken Martin and the DNC are managing decline — to the tune of $18M in debt while Republicans outraise us 8 to 1.**
All of this coming on the heels of Ken Martin botching the 2024 election autopsy, failing to answer basic questions about why we lost to Trump _again_ and what we’re going to do about it (not to mention the fact that he left the entire “Conclusion” section blank!).
I’ve said it before and I’ll keep saying it: the solution to our party’s failure is _NOT_ going to come from inside this DNC.
These political insiders are trapped in a cycle of damage control and self preservation. If we want a movement that actually fights for working people, is capable of taking on Trump’s agenda, and winning — _we have to get in the dirt and do it ourselves._
**That’s exactly why Leaders We Deserve exists.** We do the work the establishment is refusing to do. We don’t protect the status quo. We back candidates who won’t hesitate to take on MAGA extremism and who actually have the guts to fight for the people not corporate special interests and give us hope for the future.
And we need you with us today to continue doing the work of electing a truly new generation of leaders that will return the Democratic party to a winning coalition in 2026 and beyond.
**[While Ken Martin and the DNC manage crisis after crisis, we’re building the real long term power we need to reignite our party and win. Will you pitch in $5 right now to help us elect the next generation of leaders?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260727_1_dnc.9peXyQ&refcode=em20260727-3779&amount=5&t=2&akid=3779%2E587540%2ETjlo2Y)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Team,
Donald Trump recently nominated four candidates for the USPS Board of Governors in an attempted takeover of the cherished public institution that is older than the nation itself. And he knows good and well USPS is responsible for carrying millions of ballots during the midterm elections.
The Postal Board controls the policy decisions, financials, service standards, and long-term direction of USPS. It also has sole hire and fire power over the Postmaster General.
Our coalition made enough noise that two of the nominees never made it to a vote , but the other two – Jeffrey Brodsky and William Gallo – were just voted out of committee and the entire Senate could soon vote to confirm or reject them.
This is our last chance to stop Trump from dominating the postal board and being able to bully a giant step forward on his election interference schemes, as well as everything from price hikes and delivery slowdowns to privatization.
Demand the Senate reject these disastrous nominees while we still can >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-postal-board-takeover/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
START WRITING NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-postal-board-takeover/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
Rural communities, Indigenous communities, seniors, veterans, small businesses, postal workers, and voters shouldn’t pay the price while private shipping corporations claim the profitable pieces. But that's exactly what these guys want.
Brodsky has spent 30 years in the corporate restructuring world, treating distressed companies as projects to be cut apart, reorganized, and squeezed for investors — a literal privatization expert. Gallo comes from commodities trading and private business. Neither one has any postal experience or much less a record of defending universal service, postal workers, affordable rates, rural delivery, or election mail.
We have no reason to believe anything other than these corporate stooges are ready and willing to do whatever Trump wants regardless of the impact on one of the most trusted, effective, and respected public services in the country.
A Trump-dominated board will almost certainly weaken protections for election mail , putting vote by mail at risk for the midterms and beyond.
Trump wants a Postal Service that follows his political orders and prepares itself for a corporate sell-off. The Senate can stop him. Send your letter right now! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-postal-board-takeover/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

David, this campaign has always been about communicating with passion, substance, and integrity. If weʼre going to spend the money to reach 60,000 voters, you better believe weʼre going to have something important to say.

Peter,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I did not seek this moment, Peter.

But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. **[However, I cannot do this alone.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/Sw6A1IhF-wm6KnLyZ1L6LTbIDPq9Ycwji8UtXbR0euIX_0AbfudaGI53UiQ5B717hYs4kEG5gt-5I8CJuuJiUamoiVLtSv2mbRSzvOlWLI5nkMrf5UaYNnu7S2u6dmuCU7wqL4QZMAccM2BVsqX38l1Vvg4BXzc8PVdk8fFYsvnWv26Zvo871JsU3q0l2C3sCeg6fm8XHqU9pdXRnR6pyswPcXlQRNLcOctxGFCvAFRNJiZtEUQYZYdx82y1dTmkXQLQ1mkszpzXkzostT0AP8Z7vFTthEKUxLfLmSAJEiPBC8ggYjiXTID5DncVLJheByQXRF6Goq3B1Afetw3aXxHsGaabmSQn7g3DG-MiDi31YfdduofY0xCJXlz3KU-_ZAp_7ruw_3SCVG-9PftgALNu0SS89fQVe5idhWHddvAsIzk_Gi7HC9cJcppoQP0i6TPbvJeEu4WUOyGnnreqLORMwUwZ8ER6q4PiH6g1u6Z0jHXAWqQ36lu4Em6H5ZVk1YcP_A2yyK9U4w_UYrbK_TCRemQ4fomZr7vgW-y4mLObRMD690HvmlXWZjuz0C8VcafNHufK7WHG7l9NK7PbCZfERhnN0Inws5n8snlh_wAqi8_BLmJO8SJW8U2_CAPP7rEfB7eeTcwPGalphhSd9HQhS3jHpdqxmx8eEtkSzvk4wc7eDmEOB1ck_h_qlIzUOJI7UDH8jGxDfVLVaHGKNVieKS9CnxFYkCvx4SNi0fPaYdB65uk0VW7bcgAhCUQohyCTWhG_2sUOdsnyg0jokcVZV_XDIEuy8W9HA-f1yVAgRtWhO6z9S8zgY5p7ChWNAIjhcsw1HFbiKZuX-VLiv5Pp_BT72_4n1C4XulHoHbxcq0FVced_s4qHjL0DsR5NvxZkFGFZctJ8aPTlt5wHoLI/AJvvnwLmVibqUPL77MNXkVhQGUR0-rgL/23)**

clean_body: | Peter, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Peter. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 3 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. name: Dan Cox
subject: Join Me This August
body:
Two opportunities to spend time together and hear what's next for Maryland.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/9ra4LYX0ClP?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
| | | | | |
# Join Me This August
---
| | Friends,
The campaign trail doesn't slow down in August, and I hope you'll join me at one (or both!) of these upcoming events.
Whether you join us for an afternoon picnic or an evening conversation about Maryland's future, I'd love the opportunity to thank you personally for standing with us.
Every conversation matters. Every supporter matters. And with voting starting in 56 days, there's never been a more important time to come together.
I hope to see you there.

---
|
---
| | **Picnic Under the Tent****Saturday, August 8 | 4:00–7:00 PM****Endless Call Farm | Davidsonville, MD**
Some of the best conversations I’ve had on the campaign trail happen around a picnic table. I hope you'll join me for an afternoon of great food, good company, and honest conversation about the future of Maryland. Join me to hear where we’re headed and how we’re building momentum across Maryland.
Whether you've been with us from the beginning or are just getting involved, I'd love the opportunity to meet you, answer your questions, and thank you personally for your support.
---
| [Join Us in Davidsonville](https://us.list-manage.com/10eGz0uYmPr?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
---
|
---
| | **An Evening with Dan Cox & Former Governor Bob Ehrlich****Tuesday, August 11 | 6:00–9:00 PM****The Hartman Home | Annapolis, MD**
I'm grateful to have former Governor Bob Ehrlich joining me for an evening with you to share my vision to renew Maryland. We'll discuss the road to victory, how we can reverse what Wes Moore has done to our beautiful state, and what it will take to restore strong, principled leadership in Annapolis.
Come hear directly from us and spend the evening with fellow supporters. I hope you'll join us.
---

name: JoCasta Zamarripa
subject: Trump's DOJ is coming after us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by JoCasta for WI
body:
I helped pass this law. I'm not backing down. | |
---
| | [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/18jc8z1Dour?e=8d919f2092&c2id=0bdcb6d83cbc8b2aaf05afb952b88bb7)
---
| | Friend,

Donald Trump's Department of Justice has filed a lawsuit against my city. They are suing Milwaukee over an ordinance that my colleagues and I, on the Common Council, passed unanimously this spring.

What does that ordinance do? It says that law enforcement officers cannot hide their faces to conceal their identities while they detain people on our streets. That’s it. If armed men are boxing in cars, breaking windows, and pulling people out, our residents have a right to know they are who they claim to be.
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/BAZryrqbZ8d?e=8d919f2092&c2id=0bdcb6d83cbc8b2aaf05afb952b88bb7)
---
|
We passed this because we watched masked, unidentified agents carry out immigration raids in our neighborhoods. Families were terrified. No one could tell a real officer from an impersonator. So we acted, the way local leaders are supposed to when Washington will not.

Now the Trump administration is trying to punish us for it. Their message to every city in America is simple: fall in line, or we will target you next.

I have spent my career refusing to shut up and fall in line. I grew up on the south side of Milwaukee, and I have never waited for permission to stand up and fight for the people I represent.

And I am not about to start now.

But I need to be honest with you. Fighting back against the full weight of the federal government takes resources, and this is exactly the kind of fight I am asking you to send me to Madison to keep waging. **As Wisconsin's next Secretary of State, I will use that statewide platform to defend our communities, our democracy, and our right to hold power accountable, from Kenosha to Superior.**

[They are betting we will be intimidated and stay silent. Let's prove them wrong.Will you chip in $15, $35, or $50 today to help me keep up this fight?](https://us.list-manage.com/16GIGMVx7OT?e=8d919f2092&c2id=0bdcb6d83cbc8b2aaf05afb952b88bb7)

---
| | | | JoCasta Zamarripa is a lifelong Milwaukeean, a proud daughter of the city’s south side, and a dedicated public servant who’s never stopped fighting for working people. Born and raised in the very neighborhoods she now represents, JoCasta has spent her life pushing for progress that reflects the realities of everyday Wisconsinites.

[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/Em_34IV3K7P?e=8d919f2092&c2id=0bdcb6d83cbc8b2aaf05afb952b88bb7)

She made history as the first Latina and first openly bi member of both the Wisconsin State Legislature and the Milwaukee Common Council. But JoCasta’s leadership is defined by more than her historic firsts—it's grounded in results. She served ten years in the State Assembly and is now in her second term as Alderperson for Milwaukee’s 8th District, where she’s led major efforts on affordable housing, small business licensing reform, and community development.

In 2025, she was the lead sponsor of the Housing Element Plan, a key step in addressing Milwaukee’s housing crisis by expanding affordable options and preventing displacement. Her approach is practical and persistent—building coalitions, navigating political challenges, and staying rooted in the neighborhoods she serves.

Now, JoCasta is running as a Democrat for Wisconsin Secretary of State to use the platform to fight for what matters: more funding for our schools so families aren’t forced into referenda every election, real housing relief for working people, and affordable child care that lets parents breathe.

|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136103598/636358971/954579451?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOTRiOWQyMC1mZTg5LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HSoc5fNb7CbSsfd1Vi3qrkvpfeDPH4sJ5eWtJwApdTs=)
Peter,

With the end of month deadline approaching, I imagine you’re receiving a lot of messages from candidates like me.

**I don’t want to pile on, but I’ll be direct: I was one of the only Democrats to flip a GOP-held seat in 2024. And the path to the House majority runs through CA-27.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136103599/636358972/954579451?refcode=em-7.27.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOTRiOWQyMC1mZTg5LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HSoc5fNb7CbSsfd1Vi3qrkvpfeDPH4sJ5eWtJwApdTs=) | ****[Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136103600/636358973/954579451?refcode=em-7.27.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOTRiOWQyMC1mZTg5LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HSoc5fNb7CbSsfd1Vi3qrkvpfeDPH4sJ5eWtJwApdTs=)****

With control of the House comes the much-needed accountability over the Trump Administration. Right now, my GOP colleagues in Congress are doing nothing amidst the chaos -- and working families are paying the price.

I’m not backing down in Congress, because I owe it to the San Fernando, Santa Clarita, and Antelope Valleys to deliver results that have an impact. But I’m aware of the target that makes me.

$15 MILLION in outside spending was used against me in 2024. We expect attacks to come as we move closer to the election -- and we need to prepare.

name: Stop Data Centers via Our Revolution
subject: Add your name: Moratorium on new data centers, NOW
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

From Georgia to California, regular people are rising up to stop massive
data centers from overrunning their communities. But as AI-funded
politicians try to push these water-hogging, power-thirsty facilities
through, we need to FORCE Congress to stop the data center rush.

Communities are coming together to tell Big Tech we will NOT accept the
utter devastation these facilities cause: millions of gallons of water,
nonstop noise, sky-high utility bills, scarce water for drinking and
farming, and more. In the last year, more than 300 cities, towns, and
counties have banned or paused massive data center construction.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39277?source=email-20260727&t=1011&akid=11112%2E5885482%2E5bHNYO ]Headline: Community Backlash to AI Data Centers Is Growing Across the
U.S.

We’re seeing a mass movement. But to truly stop this runaway data center
surge, we need NATIONAL action. Bernie and AOC have introduced a bill that
would enforce a nationwide moratorium on new data centers – and we ALL
need to stand with them.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39277?source=email-20260727&t=1012&akid=11112%2E5885482%2E5bHNYO ]Add your name now to demand Congress stop the data center gold rush,
NOW!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39277?source=email-20260727&t=1013&akid=11112%2E5885482%2E5bHNYO ]ADD YOUR NAME

We know what happens when data centers move in: 24-hour noise, water
shortages, and sharp hikes to our power bills – on top of Trump’s energy
price hikes. This is about ultra-wealthy investors destroying our
communities for their own profits, while our neighborhoods, environment,
and wallets pay the price.

A new poll confirmed it: Only a third of Americans want more data centers.
Just 14% would accept one being built nearby. Americans in 142 towns –
across 42 states – just stood together in protest during a national day of
action demanding a halt to unchecked data center expansion. Our Revolution
organizer Susana Williams joined a youth-led protest in Pittsburg, CA,
alongside a 14-year-old climate leader with a clear message: our health
and safety are not for sale.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39277?source=email-20260727&t=1014&akid=11112%2E5885482%2E5bHNYO ]Photo of protestors holding a banner that reads STOP PITTSBURG DATA
CENTER

Local governments are listening. In just the first three months of this
year, 75 major projects – worth over $130 BILLION – were either delayed or
canceled. But tech giants are still racing to build HUNDREDS more. To
protect every community, we need nationwide action.

That’s why Congress must pass a federal moratorium on new data centers
until Congress passes real rules to protect our planet, water, and
neighborhoods. Wall Street and the tech giants are already lobbying hard
to kill it, but we’re not backing down.

Our Revolution is recruiting our 30,000-strong Citizen Action Team to
bring relentless outside pressure: calling, organizing, and showing up to
stand up for community needs.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39277?source=email-20260727&t=1015&akid=11112%2E5885482%2E5bHNYO ]Add your name to demand a FEDERAL halt to reckless AI data centers –
before it’s too late.

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

Peter,
Sick of so-called "moderate" Republicans pretending to be reasonable when the cameras are rolling but then turning around and voting for Donald Trump's authoritarian agenda 100% of the time?
Us too. That's why we have to win this critical House seat in November:
Nebraska's 2nd congressional district voted for Kamala Harris in 2024 by 5 points. GOP Rep. Don Bacon survived for years posing as a moderate to voters while eagerly enabling Trump's worst impulses back in DC.
That stops now. Don Bacon read the writing on the wall--seeing that Democratic enthusiasm to put an end to Trump's lawlessness was surging, he threw in the towel and chose to retire instead of facing the voters with his pro-MAGA sellout voting record.
The Democrat running to replace Bacon is Denise Powell, a fierce advocate for voting rights who founded a statewide nonprofit called Women Who Run Nebraska that empowers women leaders to run for local office. Powell just posted a strong FEC report showing that she outraised her MAGA opponent by nearly half a million dollars.

# Dear Friends:

Did you see the latest poll from [Morning Consult](https://us.list-manage.com/13W14ubhG3S?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c)?

**_It shows Governor Scott with a 71% approval rating, placing him at the top of the list for the Nation... again! _**

_But... that’s not the poll you’re reading about in the news._

The poll that has everyone talking shows the Governor down from that number, and possible challengers are trying to making hay, using it to raise money and hoping to chip away at the Governor’s record.

**_They’re desperately trying to blame the Affordability Crisis created by Democratic majorities in the legislature over the last thirty years on Governor Scott._**

_We _ALL_ know the truth... and that’s not it!_

Look, the Governor has broad support from mainstream, common-sense Vermonters who understand the need for balance and a steady hand at the wheel to lower taxes, build more homes, and fix the broken systems that are nickel and diming us while failing to deliver results.

**_That’s why we need your help, by donating today to help push back against the false narratives, spread the Governor’s message far and wide, and help to elect responsible legislators across the state who can turn the tide on the costly issues facing our state._**

With the election only a few months away, we need all the support we can to build a coalition of Vermonters who see the need for mainstream, proven ideas to lower the finical burden on everyone and make it easier and more affordable to live, work, and raise a family right here in Vermont.

_I know we can count on you!_

Thanks in advance for your help,
**_Emma_**
Emma Shouldice
_**Team Scott**_

**99 days.** That's all that stands between us and the most consequential midterms in decades. So today, I want to ask: what kind of country do you want to live in? One where every child can breathe clean air and drink clean water? Where our leaders answer to the people — not the corporations lining their campaign accounts? Where free speech and the right to protest remain the bedrock of a thriving democracy? I know what kind of country I’m fighting for over these next 99 days, but I'll be honest with you about what we're up against: relentless dark money groups, corporate special interests, and Big Oil's billions. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136104775/636362915/2105508926?refcode=ea.358f4e75-028a-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.358f4e75-028a-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM1OGY0ZTc1LTAyOGEtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1dmkIignOWbvmvhBGtowkfXmpXcbPKtxinMVhb0BH6I=) It's the same playbook it's always been. Year after year, we’ve seen Koch Industries, Chevron, and their front groups spend millions on lies and misinformation designed to smear good candidates and keep our communities in the dark. **These are exactly the races where we begin to unrig the system and bring real leadership to places that have been ignored for far too long._And our opponents know it._** That's why they'll spare no expense to stop the momentum we're building. They will keep funneling millions into deception because they are terrified of what happens when people power wins. So we have to be ready. name: Adam Kinzinger (via MaggieHassan.com)
subject: what courage looks like
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH
body:
| This is former Congressman Adam Kinzinger.

The average working-class American plays by the rules, pays their taxes, doesn't cheat, doesn't steal... then watches the President of the United States and his closest allies do all of those things and face zero consequences.

What does that tell them about our political system?

**It tells them it's rigged.**

Here’s the truth: we can’t fix that cynicism with a hope poster.

We can fix it by electing people who will actually do something about it: brave Democrats who will stand up to MAGA extremism, hold politicians accountable, and put our country before politics.

That's exactly why I launched my new PAC, Back the Bold.

**Our mission is to support Democrats with the courage to say what needs to be said and do what needs to be done to hold Trump and his administration accountable.**

name: Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, retired
subject: They are clearing the way for the Arc de Trump.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
A few weeks ago, a federal commission packed with Trump appointees voted 8 to 1 to advance the Arc de Trump
#
Peter, I need to tell you where the fight to stop Trump’s arch stands, because it’s getting worse.
A few weeks ago, a federal commission packed with Trump appointees voted 8 to 1 to advance the Arc de Trump — 250 feet tall, sitting on Memorial Circle, at the entrance to Arlington National Cemetery.
They heard nearly three hours of public opposition first. Veterans. Families. People who understand what that place means to this country. The commission listened, then voted to advance the arch anyway.
This isn't final. But it's closer than it's ever been.
The sightline between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington was designed on purpose — a quiet symbol of a reunited country — and Trump wants to put a monument to himself in the middle of it.
I've spent enough of my life on the grounds of Arlington National Cemetery to know its gravity. My father, killed in action during the Vietnam War, is buried there. Men who I trained, who served under me, are buried there. It is not the backdrop for some draft-dodging coward’s vanity.
So we're asking for $5. That's it.
$5 because Trump’s commission could force this through before most people even hear what’s happened.
$5 because we're up against a President who's made this one of the top priorities of his administration.
But really, $5 or anything you can afford. Because whatever you can give, right now, matters more than the amount itself.
[**Can we count on you? Chip in that $5 and help VoteVets raise enough hell that they can't force the Arc de Trump through in secret. Enough to stop this, once and for all.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-jul26.EhtcQh&refcode=em260727-1-120&t=1&akid=35400%2E3013755%2ETfGtyb)

A Palestinian man sits on a couch in front of a building containing shops and flats that were demolished by Israeli forces in Anzah, south of the Palestinian city of Jenin in the northern Israeli-occupied West Bank, on July 27, 2026. Photo by JOHN WESSELS / AFP via Getty Images.
RAMALLAH, occupied West Bank--In the aftermath of Friday's killings in the village of Tal, hundreds of armed Israeli settlers and soldiers launched a campaign of terror targeting Palestinian towns and villages across the occupied West Bank, with reports of home raids, shootings, assaults, mass detentions, and demolitions of property--including residential buildings, mosques, cars, agricultural equipment, and farmland.
It began when armed settlers raided Tal, which is southwest of Nablus city in the northern West Bank, at around 7 a.m. local time and opened fire. They were confronted by Palestinian residents of the village who were attempting to protect their homes and land. Just a week earlier, armed settlers had raided Tal and set fire to a Palestinian home. The family managed to escape before the house was consumed by flames.
During Friday's attack, one of the Palestinian residents, Farouq Ramadan, a father of five, managed to seize the machine gun of an Israeli settler in a moment captured on camera. Ramadan then shot one of the settlers. Ramadan, and three of his cousins-- brothers Jawad and Ibrahim Ramadan, and their cousin Imran--were then shot dead by settlers and soldiers, while two settlers were killed.
"This was self-defense. Farouq was defending himself, his uncle and his cousins. Farouq is well-known in our village--he has never gone out to confront the occupation and its forces and settlers. Had the settlers not been close to his sister's home in the village he would not have gone out," Firas al-Saifi, a local Palestinian journalist from Tal, told Drop Site. "The situation is that they raid Palestinian villages and homes and point their guns at residents, and expect them to be killed in silence."
Four others were shot and wounded at the scene by settler and soldier fire, including Orwa Ramadan, the brother of Jawad and Ibrahim, who was shot in the shoulder. Shortly after the attack, Israeli soldiers abducted Orwa from his hospital bed at the Nablus Specialty Hospital, where he was transferred for treatment. He remains detained along with another one of his brothers, Majd Ramadan, who was at work and uninvolved during the attack.
The arrests came amid a sweeping campaign of mass detentions across the West Bank by Israeli occupation forces, with more than 100 Palestinians taken into custody and interrogated, according to local officials. More than 20 remain in custody as of Monday.
Israeli forces also raided Ramadan's home, taking measurements in preparation for the planned demolition of his family home and that of his parents, who live on the lower floor of the same building. Armed settlers, accompanied by the Israeli military, established a new illegal outpost--installing caravans after uprooting hundreds of Palestinian-owned olive trees in the area.
It is one of at least six new colonial outposts reported on occupied Palestinian land as Israeli settlers take advantage of the mass crackdown they incited, in addition to the expansion of existing outposts over the past few days alone with the support of the Israeli army. Other outposts established by Israeli settlers over the weekend in Palestinian villages include in Umm Safa and Sinjil in the Ramallah governorate; in Deir Ballut in the Salfit governorate; Asira al-Shamaliya in the Nablus governorate and another existing one in Nablus, Madama, that is being expanded.
**[MORE: Video obtained by Drop Site of the new settler outpost at Tal](https://substack.com/redirect/3dea22e8-0ce2-42a3-b2d9-f1cc13ba995a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
## **Expanding Attacks and Colonization**
Once the news of the two killed Israelis emerged on Friday, hundreds more settlers attacked at least 30 different villages and locations between Friday and midday on Monday. The Israeli army not only supported the settlers but launched its own military raids.
Dozens of Palestinians were wounded, including many through live ammunition, rubber-coated bullets, rocks, pepper-spray, and physical assaults. At least seven homes, two mosques, a quarry, many cars, and farmlands were set on fire and burned, while many other properties faced arson attempts but were blocked by residents.
Reports of attacks came from numerous villages, including Tal, Surra, Qusra, Urif, Madama, Asira al-Qibliya, Burin, Iraq Burin, Qabalan, Jalud, Qaryut, Aqraba, Beita, Lubban al-Sharqiya, Wadi al-Sha'ir, Khirbat Tana al-Fawqa, Beit Furik, As-Sawiya, Tilfeet, and Huwwara in the Nablus district; Jit, Fara'ta, and Immatin in the Qalqilya district; Kur in the Tulkarem district; Sinjil, Beitillu, and Ein Samiya in the Ramallah and al-Bireh district; Surif in the Hebron district; and al-Maniya in the Bethlehem district.
Compounding the attacks, the Israeli army imposed a suffocating lockdown on Palestinian cities and severed movement between towns and villages, effectively trapping residents as the attacks were underway. Because of blocked access to essential services, according to local medics, there have been at least four cases of Palestinian women being forced to give birth at military closures and checkpoints over the weekend, with ambulances blocked from evacuating them. On Monday, one woman tragically delivered a stillborn after enduring severe bleeding due to the closures by the Israeli army. Soldiers held the ambulance for more than 30 minutes at Nablus, searched the woman despite her condition, and ordered the crew to switch off the vehicle's engine, shutting down its medical equipment. The woman survived after reaching hospital, but lost her baby.
Bashar Qaryouti, a volunteer medic and activist from the village of Qaryout south of Nablus city, explained that the current period marks a clear shift. "We used to be afraid of the night--we called the settlers 'bats' because they used to carry out their attacks under the cover of darkness. Now, they commit all their crimes in broad daylight without a care in the world," Qaryouti told Drop Site.
Following the killings, Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, who is also in charge of the building of illegal colonies in the occupied West Bank, [called for](https://substack.com/redirect/df149b04-88c7-4726-9063-0731bc84589f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the destruction of Palestinian villages and the transfer of their residents, and demanded the expansion of Israeli colonies. A [similar statement](https://substack.com/redirect/0ff9cbf9-2df1-44f8-9f2b-df0276b1d4f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was made by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz, who announced a series of measures, among them the building of new colonies.
While most settler attacks in recent years have focused on Palestinians living in Area C--the area comprising roughly 60 percent of the occupied West Bank and excluding the built-up areas of Palestinian cities and villages--settler violence is now increasingly moving into Areas A and B, where the majority of Palestinian villages are located.
"We are in a new stage. The settlers and soldiers have emptied about 99 percent of Area C through their attacks and by forcing residents out, and now the settlers are moving into the villages and attacking them. They have begun taking over homes on the edges of villages and launching attacks deep inside our towns," Qaryouti said.
One of the new outposts is in Deir Istya, a historic Palestinian town in the Salfit governorate in the northern West Bank. "The place where they established [one of the new outposts] is the only remaining open space available for the people of Deir Istya to expand their construction in the future. The area they have taken control of covers 44 dunams (around 10 acres)," Izzat Mansour, the mayor of Deir Istya, told Drop Site on Monday. "They set up tents there last night, and since three o'clock this morning Israeli army forces have been present there. All the surrounding areas of Deir Istya are already enclosed by settlers."
"We see that what happened to our people in 1948 is now being repeated in the West Bank," Mansour added, referring to the mass expulsion of 750,000 Palestinians from their homes by Zionist militias in what is known as the Nakba, Arabic for 'catastrophe.' "There is continuous and systematic daily harassment from different directions by settlers. We are using every means available to us to continue living on these lands, to resist displacement, and to prevent them from gaining control over these areas and imposing a new reality."
Routine attacks by Israeli settlers and soldiers on Palestinians in the West Bank have been taking place for decades, but over the last few years, particularly since the genocide in Gaza began in 2023, they have significantly increased and become more organized. The Israeli military also increasingly shows up to support the settlers' actions.
Sinjil, a Palestinian village northeast of Ramallah, was close to one of the new outposts established this weekend. "Before the events of Tal--two or three days before--Sinjil was attacked by dozens of armed settlers. They fired live ammunition directly at people...The settlers have gone far beyond all limits. Their attacks have escalated to the point where they enter people's homes, vandalize shops, vandalize houses. These are systematic attacks. They steal money--anything they can get their hands on," Mohammad Ghafry, a resident of Sinjil. "Since the events in Tal, they have tightened the closure of Sinjil. All of the town's entrances have been completely sealed off."
"In addition to that, they established a new settlement outpost in the eastern plain," Ghafry added. "These lands belong to al-Mazra'a al-Sharqiya, not Sinjil, but the outpost is located at Sinjil's eastern entrance. The settlers in this outpost have effectively become like the army's eyes."
Before the attacks on Tal, more than 80 Palestinians had already been killed by Israeli soldiers and settlers in the occupied West Bank so far in 2026, according to the Palestinian Health Ministry
The coordination between armed settlers and Israeli occupation forces is painfully clear, Qaryouti said. "They have worked together for a long time, but now they do it openly."
"Both the occupation authorities and the settlers are deliberately pushing Palestinians towards an explosion because it serves their broader settlement plan."

"Before the events of Tal--two or three days before--Sinjil was attacked by dozens of armed settlers. They fired live ammunition directly at people...The settlers have gone far beyond all limits. Their attacks have escalated to the point where they enter people's homes, vandalize shops, vandalize houses. These are systematic attacks. They steal money--anything they can get their hands on," Mohammad Ghafry, a resident of Sinjil. "Since the events in Tal, they have tightened the closure of Sinjil. All of the town's entrances have been completely sealed off." "In addition to that, they established a new settlement outpost in the eastern plain," Ghafry added. "These lands belong to al-Mazra'a al-Sharqiya, not Sinjil, but the outpost is located at Sinjil's eastern entrance. The settlers in this outpost have effectively become like the army's eyes." Before the attacks on Tal, more than 80 Palestinians had already been killed by Israeli soldiers and settlers in the occupied West Bank so far in 2026, according to the Palestinian Health Ministry The coordination between armed settlers and Israeli occupation forces is painfully clear, Qaryouti said. "They have worked together for a long time, but now they do it openly." "Both the occupation authorities and the settlers are deliberately pushing Palestinians towards an explosion because it serves their broader settlement plan." | A guest post by| Tahhan is an independent TV reporter and writer based in occupied Jerusalem. # Pete Hegseth Wants to Erase Women’s History... Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs Won’t Let Him.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1BMGJo2EpWW?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**For years, women fought for the chance to serve our country in every capacity.**
We proved we could.We met the standards. We led soldiers. We commanded tanks. We deployed. We earned our place—not because anyone lowered the bar, but because we cleared it.
Now Pete Hegseth is trying to rewrite that history, and ensure women are not apart of the future.
He's claiming women only entered combat arms because standards were lowered. That isn't true. There has never been evidence to support that claim. In fact, the evidence shows the opposite: women graduated the same schools, met the same requirements, and strengthened our military by expanding the pool of qualified leaders.
**I know because I lived it.**
I was one of the first 50 women in the United States Army to serve in combat arms. I led tank platoons, integrated one of the Army's first infantry battalions to include women, and earned outstanding evaluations from the soldiers and commanders I served beside. I wasn't given anything. I earned every opportunity through hard work, sacrifice, and leadership. I am just like all the women who came before me.
When political leaders erase that history, they aren't just attacking women.
They're attacking the integrity of our military.
Our armed forces become stronger by selecting the best leaders—not by excluding qualified Americans to score political points. Recruiting is already facing historic challenges. We cannot afford to tell half the country that their service doesn't matter.
This is about more than me.
It's about every little girl who dreams of serving. Every young woman currently wearing the uniform. Every mother who raised a daughter to believe she could lead. And every soldier who deserves to know promotions and assignments are based on merit—not politics.
**That's why I'm running for Congress.**
In eight days, Virginia's First District has the opportunity to nominate a new generation of leadership. A veteran. A foster parent. A proven leader who isn't afraid to stand up to Pete Hegseth, Donald Trump, or anyone else who weakens our military for political gain.
Rob Wittman has enabled this administration every step of the way.I won't.
If elected, I will fight to protect the integrity of our military, defend equal opportunity for every qualified service member, and make sure no politician gets to erase the service and sacrifice of the women who fought for this country.
The question isn't whether women belong in combat.We've already answered that.
The question is: **Who will fight for the women who fight for us?**
I'm asking for your vote, your support, and your help during these final eight days.
Together, we can send a veteran to Congress who knows what service actually looks like—and who will never let anyone rewrite our history.

_**— Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs**_
Army Veteran - Congressional Candidate for VA01
P.S. Every phone call, every conversation, every volunteer shift, and every contribution matters in these final eight days. If you believe our military should be led by facts, integrity, and the best qualified Americans—not political ideology—please chip in today and help us finish strong.

# What we need & what we did this week.
---
|
---
| |
## Volunteers
---
| | Volunteering for a campaign is challenging. Even more so when you are donating your time. We haven’t seen many large donations come in and I cannot afford to pay for expensive campaign management groups.
We need volunteers for the following roles:
* Communications Director
* Social Media Manager
* Field Organizer
* Handler

We also need volunteers to accompany us for events and town halls, and canvassers to phone bank and door knock. This is an **ALL HANDS ON DECK** request!
---
| |
## Parades
---
| | Sanpete County came out and delivered! The Pioneer Day Parades in Spring City and Fairview were so much fun.
I attended the fireman’s breakfast and enjoyed all the great conversations with everyone at the table.
We were very well received at both parades, and I always have a fun time getting the crowds riled up and cheering.[Check out our video of the parade here.](https://us.list-manage.com/5H9NEmU9t2o?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=ihiq06eyWITwzyFsLmn5PvVCL421Ol3dMSU8wmqRp_AS92oFZiRXIrmfRPk8)
---
| |
## Rep. Kennedy votes for the war
---
| | Last week was another jam packed week of news. Mike Kennedy, along with the rest of our Congressional delegation, voted _**NAY**_ on the War Powers Resolution. My heart aches for the families of the four American service members who paid the ultimate price for our country this month.
The day before, they voted in favor of a _**$95 billion**_ blueprint to increase funding for the war. That war has Utah's average gas price above _**$4 a gallon**_ and the price of oil above $100 a barrel.
The bill that passed to stop Congress from trading stocks _only_ stops members from _buying new individual stocks_. What they already own, they keep, and they can still sell. It _**did not include**_ the _President_ , _Vice President_ or the _Administration_. Bolted onto the bill were _**voter ID**_ items that would directly impact Utah and our mail-in voting. It would _**require**_ you to mail a _photocopy of your ID_ in with your ballot.
Please check out our [Facebook page](https://us.list-manage.com/11aPYZqZuKG?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=wVdxeD8bZKOdwvXv9gvp8JyswPyfrBTCRjpGIpt1eBspwaketny40fvYCOyr) to read more on these issues and many others.

subject: Are we China’s b*tch?

body:
Are we China's b*tch? Time to stand up and put America first.
# ARE WE
CHINA'S B*TCH?
Peter,
I didn’t sign up for that. We are Americans, sovereign citizens of this nation. We are not slaves, serfs, or tributaries to any other country! Whether that be China, Qatar, or Europe! The beating heart of this movement is that we’re tired of being a tributary.
Where is all the rage? Why aren’t we all as angry about this as I am? Muslims and Marxists are gonna ruin this country for your descendants. I’m sick and tired of bending the knee to them.
Every day we buy billions worth of products from Communist China. Every day we buy billions worth of oil from the Gulf nations. You know where that money goes? The Chinese use it to lobby our politicians for favorable trade legislation, the Qataris pour it into our universities in exchange for influence over students, the Saudis use it to buy our sports teams and leagues, and the UAE uses it to attract our people to Dubai.
I didn’t sign up for that, and I’m damn sure you didn’t either. We are building a reliance on these countries to the point where they will get to pull our strings. We are America, we shouldn’t need anyone. We need to be using our own products and our own oil because we are in really dangerous territory now.
**[Stand with me now so we can show them we are not their puppets!](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=00418c7ed4ff4118ab755945ae2337ad&_e=d6vK8xEvAWb8HhLCvnAqU2sd5pKQKEtlBmcGcTdTckgv_El7yTa6SWNhBY-oJBtChvi0WJ0cPGv_2s8xaaEOEMNPppnXhB4GsrD8X5UF57yPL9pOpxupJe8cYEuMnj40be1Ua23AqrU4BGDhiHKCrhRsPh42PnjmqwgO69WAlH3FXIHGll55hY1XKwJ7Yi1i05FQ4MJmJeYaPegmcoVoT-GGyqkADOYEz28av4VZepxzn7uCjYUI-v3TRhmcBBUwv2gq-oFnWePomTXDoki-30SGCnyZNcFs5PXF9r98h2F4fms5YTzaWkJxeNrh4tlNV3FvvHVg0YuuLIG52NQGZLUaXmKDxz37g0u0VkweZRvz5952fV0nWP4m-UaeCA0k5Gc1cg3V-imYOqAXc0TWJvFAPid5mQXi5CMPodGtr03vfWfHTp-nYQg8zQQDjawXRdCYXLaWsPApoyv2QuloxcIcDvYu5n4N8pexwtfiTUIan3P6b8hgcI8Y5QSufIOm1VNFomEYNUjx5GPLf_ogcSxXeAsGrnPA1dZtVOYjSz4%3D)**
