body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM4NTk1MDkS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjUwMDE1Njk2NgS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
LAST CHANCE: Stop the Sell-Off of Chaco Canyon!

The Trump administration is seeking to sell off over 330,000 acres around Chaco
Culture National Historic Park for oil and gas leasing. We need to stop this sell-off, but we only have until July 29th to make our voices heard. Add your name today to protect Chaco Canyon. https://links.messages.lcv.

Opening this region to oil and gas development would have devastating
consequences. Chaco Culture National Historic Park is a UNESCO World Heritage
Site, and the Greater Chaco Canyon region is the ancestral home of the Pueblo
people, and a site of deep cultural, archeological, and historical significance
to dozens of Tribal Nations throughout the Southwest. These lands must remain
protected.

Join LCV in standing with the local communities who have led the fight to
protect Chaco Canyon for decades. Take action and help protect Chaco Canyon’s irreplaceable sacred lands >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/RZbkcRPvj- ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv. Peter, Trump and congressional Republicans are moving to sell off Chaco Canyon, and we
need to act. Tell the Bureau of Land Management: Chaco Canyon is not for sale! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzs~ Right now, the administration is trying to revoke the Greater Chaco mineral
withdrawal, which prohibits new oil and gas leasing on over 330,000 acres of national public lands bordering Chaco Culture National Historical Park. Chaco Canyon is the ancestral home of the Pueblo people, and a site of deep
cultural, archeological, and historical significance to dozens of Tribal Nations
throughout the Southwest. Chaco Culture National Historical Park, which is a
UNESCO World Heritage Site, safeguards more than 33,000 acres of public lands
and thousands of archeological sites. If the Bureau of Land Management moves forward with this proposal, new oil and gas drilling will be allowed within 10 miles of the park’s
boundaries, threatening irreplaceable cultural and environmental resources, and posing
serious health risks to local communities. Please don’t wait — speak up to protect our public lands today. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~ These lands are irreplaceable. Let’s make sure they’re protected for future
generations, not exploited and polluted for Big Oil’s profits. Join LCV in standing with local communities who have led the fight to protect
Chaco Canyon for decades. Thank you for taking action for our public lands! America Fitzpatrick

He carried the nuclear football for President Obama — now he's running as a Democrat to flip Michigan's 7th congressional district. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | It’s Matt Maasdam. This is a longer email — but it’s a lot of pictures. Sometimes I get questions about how this kid... ...wound up working in the East Wing of the White House and serving as President Obama’s Military Aide... ...and then got here, running for Congress in one of the most contested battleground districts in the country. Growing up, my parents taught me about the importance of public service and fighting for our country. So I became a Navy SEAL — to fight for our rights and freedoms. I swore an oath to defend the Constitution of the United States, and over 20 years in the Navy I served in some of the most dangerous and complex environments around the globe. From there, I became lead instructor for “Hell Week” at SEAL training – instilling American values into the next generation of SEALs. After that, I served as President Obama’s Military Aide, where I carried the nuclear codes for the President. In all my public service, it never mattered if I was a Democrat or a Republican. There was simply a mission, and work that needed to be done. That’s not how Washington works these days. My opponent, Congressman Tom Barrett, doesn’t do what’s right. He chases the party line so he can get his next campaign check from national Republicans. **He’s sold out this district, raising healthcare costs so that he can fund a tax break for billionaires. I’m running for Congress to hold him accountable. Polling shows that we have the clearest path to beating him, but first we need to have the resources to keep up a competitive operation. And with our primary in just over a week, there’s never been a more important moment to make your first donation. It is harder to put food on the table.
It is harder to pay the electric bill.

name: Larry David
subject: This is cutting into nap time…
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Vindman for Florida
body:
Surprised to hear from me?
# [](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1135?t=1&akid=948%2E3892029%2E93LAlf)

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/av-em-q32026?refcode=em260727-2&refcode2=948_3892029_93LAlf&akid=948%2E3892029%2E93LAlf)
---
Hey Peter! This is Larry David. Surprised to hear from me? Well, I’m as surprised as you are. You think I wanted to do this? This is cutting into nap time. But I couldn’t say no to Alex Vindman. He’s running for Senate in Florida. I like that Vindman. The man is everything I’m not, which should give you some idea of what a tremendous person he is.
The guy’s a hero — a real one. He sacrificed his career to testify in front of Congress about how Trump tried to blackmail Zelensky, the President of Ukraine.
You know, I’m a nice guy. I don’t like to criticize people, but I’m willing to bet that the woman running against him wouldn’t sacrifice her career for anything. I’m also willing to bet that every vote she’ll ever cast will be because Trump wanted her to vote that way:
“Yes, Mr. President! Whatever you say, Mr. President. You’re the greatest, Mr. President. Build more monuments to yourself, Mr. President? I’ll vote for it! Gut the Affordable Care Act? I’ll vote for it! Go to war with Iran without a plan to end it? I’ll support it. Use your office to enrich yourself and your family? I won’t say a word. Do anything I can to help you distract from the Epstein files? Sure, here's some more UFO footage! Lie every second of every day? I’ll go along with it, because I’m a puppet and I don’t have a mind of my own. I’m just a little sock.”
Vindman is not a puppet. He has a moral compass that doesn’t allow him to sell out. His family immigrated from Ukraine. They had nothing. He loves this country. He loves it so much it’s almost off-putting. I love it too, but come on. Get a life, Vindman! There’s more to life than serving America.
**Now here’s the awful part...Right, you got it. Money. Alas, you can’t get elected without money for a campaign.** I get it if you don’t want to give anything. Who wants to give money to someone you don’t know? Who wants to give money to someone you know?!
[**But even if it’s a small amount, it might be worth it if you elect someone who’s different, who has a backbone, and who’s actually a good guy. And who knows — you might personally need something from your senator one day. And this I guarantee — he will respond. And if he can help you, he will. As my mother used to say, “He’s a living doll.”**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/av-em-q32026?refcode=em260727-2&amount=3&refcode2=948_3892029_93LAlf&akid=948%2E3892029%2E93LAlf)

| | | Peter,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack.

Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God.

That's why your support matters.

For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed. And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives. Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for. He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly. That's why your support matters. It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build. | | | Now's the time to act. Peter, **Republicans are taking a Supreme Court ruling about transgender student athletics and using it as an****excuse to rewrite civil rights protections****for every school that receives federal funding.** That means a student could lose more than their place on a team. They could _lose the fundamental promise_ that their school will protect them from discrimination and exclusion. House Republicans just advanced the _Title IX Clarification Act of 2026_ , a bill that would define “sex” under Title IX as only biologically determined male or female. This would erase LGBTQ+ students, especially transgender students, from protections schools are supposed to enforce. **Peter****, this is how they shrink our rights one step at a time.** A decision from the captured Court decision justifies new legislation, which becomes the basis for another legal challenge, tightening the screws until**families and students are left fighting a system built against them.** United for Democracy is fighting to reform the Court, repair our democracy, and build a system that answers to the people, not the extremists trying to roll back our rights case by case. clean_body: | | Peter, Republicans are taking a Supreme Court ruling about transgender student athletics and using it as anexcuse to rewrite civil rights protectionsfor every school that receives federal funding. That means a student could lose more than their place on a team. They could lose the fundamental promise that their school will protect them from discrimination and exclusion. House Republicans just advanced the Title IX Clarification Act of 2026 , a bill that would define “sex” under Title IX as only biologically determined male or female. This would erase LGBTQ+ students, especially transgender students, from protections schools are supposed to enforce. Peter, this is how they shrink our rights one step at a time. A decision from the captured Court decision justifies new legislation, which becomes the basis for another legal challenge, tightening the screws untilfamilies and students are left fighting a system built against them. United for Democracy is fighting to reform the Court, repair our democracy, and build a system that answers to the people, not the extremists trying to roll back our rights case by case. I had a debate coach who told me to be a “happy warrior” by drawing a smiley face on my debate notes when I was on the podium. And I thought... that’s just so saccharine. _A smiley face is not going to make me smile._
Instead, I thought about what would make me smile. **Saying “It’s Shark Week” has always fired me up.** It makes me think about how proud I am to be a Michigander. How we roll up our sleeves and get things done.
And like sharks, we don’t stop swimming. I started writing “It’s Shark Week” on the top of my debate notes to get me in the zone, and it stuck! I’ve been saying it for years, and it always makes me smile.

But there's too much on the line to stop swimming now.
Here's to a great Shark Week,
Gretchen Whitmer

Inside Scoop Issue: 7/27/2026
Iran War Enters Diplomatic Pause
The U.S.-Iran war has entered its most significant lull in weeks, with American forces [holding fire](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDFyrDAQRE8DmSgYEIJAwU_I9qcOqUEaLeMVSIXEYvv0Lq7gsDt41f0-HvMD2fP-_I8baU5ptsHOfOB-4UF7piNZjj5smNlEnKGGXtRKgJrRZH7T3GFptYRmcENJulGDbMa-q_ty1bRYcOhM4-TohgWMdLKxRtlxca0dZMn65tUKFLSyha4i66RcAPsFqFOjKrr6jBYzVbwntpRMCDEGz5lNqsLxLL1ec46paP8VMBUwXddVufC105UqE7YCJs9vEncuYDqTuL-JSGhIpHwgZ7GGYzt_REb_SnfHL0piDd6Kz9N_C-jLQ9t4sfec-nvSc0P2N73Mf1X21vAbAAD__wqXgLo) for a second straight day after 13 consecutive nights of airstrikes over the Strait of Hormuz. The Trump administration [paused strikes](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLHSnDAQg5_GdGbsBeO7wkUauj9tSmYP73GbGNvDmp_J22d4hXRSo0_Sr6_lCzlx3n7iToFFlljiwgfmCw_KjQ6JXFPZsfFacQEDkzZeg19wbfxNy4hdDA7s4_3oKFj_cPY5jWbqPuH1HIyNjiyStfb5Ht3w8Mags27F98t1HO4848HD4AYYe4pv516A0wto9E-vRnPWiI16zsKRZC2l1pK48Sp9ObYuhU9rVdTwQ8GsYL6uq79QPpy3VnLjnaRfy65gznSJgvkmKph_n-k2tzxFVzyFREs7-A-JvvczZt3w2KiJFlpLjjriXwVzd4RYL06JZboLbjtyuhld-98DvwP8CwAA__-iD4KB) to create space for renewed technical and political talks, even as the naval blockade on Iranian ports stays firmly in place. Qatari and Pakistani mediators report meaningful progress, and Prime Minister Netanyahu has signaled support for the president's push for a settlement. The Pentagon [declined comment](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDGynDAQBU8DmSiYFRIbKHBC9p06pGY1A4wtkEoSn_LtXVzBF3ivu399LV8oQc7tJx7spJSFIi2S8bwx81k5F5IU4oFVfMIFejCqtwrsgr7KNy8aW3IjDNM6tewGO43D2-jetLvzxgxvsl6blQf9mfwK6Kk3fu1Xj9q24p693oKF1_gC3TGt4_gBNB9gbd-20f2VCCt3chYhLj7GlGKQKr50MW9tcHutqTSvHw3MDcy_r1LrziffpfPxaGC-Yw7UwHwIUWDFWGoD81XUHgPJuan1ynXnrLBW9H-KeuxVYR9PUoR_VeYUc22zo3RLCFLMw7UdKOG5aOv_dvt28C8AAP__OfqCgw) on the operational hold. Netanyahu's Washington visit this week could determine whether the fragile pause holds. ★★★
ICE Targets Haitians Losing Status
Immigration and Customs Enforcement is preparing a [major operation](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0DGStSAQBODTaIalo4gGBH9i9v50Q2uUwTdbCBTgc4-_5RU27KS76_t6rS9kx_74jydpznk1wayc0N-YyBdK2XB04cTCe8QVWhhFqwSoFffCH1oHrI2W0E12qkl3apLdPA7tWL-1HZWynbTbDGM7wdSrbd7Qyklib5XcatZPX6tAQS97GBoyVsoNcNyABjWramivaLBQwz6zobyHEGNwXHjPTUhH7fS7lJir_l8FSwXLfd-NDT-e7tzs4axguXIFC-8kYqKIibI48TskESIlLBy8KJgOKuwP8UYujD4LF_KTS8wCbaEk8hUTnST2cKUi0vWY1UmbeLNznMfn6nEiu2e1Ln-l_Gj4DQAA__-594mg) to locate and arrest Haitian nationals whose Temporary Protected Status is expiring, with the expanded push expected to begin as soon as this week. The Supreme Court's certified judgment clearing the administration to end TPS for more than 300,000 Haitians was set to reach the lower courts Monday. Federal sources say the agency will [expedite deportations](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2OpTAQhE8DGcg0xn4EDjYhm003RD12D7SEf2T3DPtuv-IKm5ZUVZ--Px_7B_LF6fiNkRy3toccdq6YbqyUhGoLXK4cUdgX3EGBGZQdwO7ohX9o19gHt8D0-nr15Cb7WqbVaGX60xlYJq2NeSkMk1I4r-ukZ1wD4UzrRD27Z09ZsDAvM-iRwteyfAKaTyBtV9tp9V0CCo2cGgdqPudS8sXCvo25Hv3lTpHSuvlXB1sH233f443t5HRITvQXIyeqo8-xg-1p-ncHG8fIR0XhnDrYtDGztfrJPQ0nsvAQqOQqg1AsuWJ9D6VmIS8UhiYo362Dra8ulJuvi5t5UI-IfD1Xvfyvyh8H_wIAAP__MpCHDw), with Springfield, Ohio, among the locations under focus. DHS moved to end TPS for over 500,000 Haitians last summer, but the matter stayed tied up in litigation until last month's high-court ruling removed the final obstacle. ★★★
Appeals Court Blocks Ballot Order
A federal appeals court dealt the administration an election-year setback, [refusing to lift](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0LGOpDAQBNCvgcwIGmND4OASsrn0QtTYzUyfbGzZnmE_f0WwP7B5Vemp_j22B7Ln8_kXAxkuZXPRbZzxvDDTWSkXx8nHgJVtwg16UKLXAvSGtvKHNomtMxMM8zG3ZAY9T8OiZK_al5lALkvvpHV2UQrVMJLaJYy09_OhaW7Z3Hu9Bg3jNILsyB3TtAOqHUjqRTeyfyeHlTo-CzsqNsaUoufKtnQxP1tvXrWm0ox_GlgbWK_r6o74ddJVOhtDA-tPvIH1IEcZvcCUCH0RNr5zFZn-k61F1PwOSezsBJ1HzJZEQPZiR-9jFTE7ygJfhE4EdpVyEOTJVo5n6TCkNhuXLvaei7rhz7t9G9r622M_Br4DAAD__0dCjm0) an injunction against key parts of Trump's executive order tightening mail-in voting rules across 23 Democratic-led states. Iran War Enters Diplomatic Pause
The U.S.-Iran war has entered its most significant lull in weeks, with American forces [holding fire](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD1uhTAQhE8DnZExP4bCRRq6lzYlWuzlsXnGRraBJKePnCOk2x1p5tPMx2N-AFlyz3fYUemLZuPNTAHcDQFdwhANHdbvkEgfMAsuesYlE3IGnejCuYXSKG36RpSoajl09di3HS83VS_r0sHS6HHo5ThCjRJXKZoBEAa9LiWpHMelkKLp2ppX3YrYoDSDHDlfEIqWn4eBhLHS3kUMF2QmOefz5V2l_V5ataV0xKJ5K8RUiOm-72r1Xw7vbNsLMVm6kOW_ENMZWa7HDgSNLKYAlNjmw37-sAT2FbNGL4xs89awz9N-M9GXQZnjJmsp9rJo-XMHsn_09N_VLiV-AwAA___JUYIh) for a second straight day after 13 consecutive nights of airstrikes over the Strait of Hormuz. The Trump administration [paused strikes](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2ypSAMgJ8GOxzEH7Sg2MbubLulEyHrya6CY1Dmvv0dziPc7kuRfJnvz2t5Ae0Utt9woHUPLT76hS4IGS4MCS_2dO7xgETuhEUrPUhlpDYLuEQPLh1U3jo_tLpC25ixb6ah61X1toNavRtVM6KHyfUTOmPaFTscV6-GyVVkyzlltNFt3zWq7v8itmj8aCalVgTRqfv0kJBrFwPj9UBxUgixUAy1i0e123dKJ4v2l9Cz0HPOuc7AbwpbiiHR8Vk_hJ4DZhZ6Llah53_3XoaCN8sTbkaWnC76jyxLAoIgE1wbJpaMLgYvPXwJPVeX9WemfScejOjUdgDtn1_STxs-Vn8HAAD__-CnhSY) to create space for renewed technical and political talks, even as the naval blockade on Iranian ports stays firmly in place. Qatari and Pakistani mediators report meaningful progress, and Prime Minister Netanyahu has signaled support for the president's push for a settlement. The Pentagon [declined comment](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGy4yAQRE-DMlx4hMAOCDZR5k03VI2ZkcUuAhUgqfb2v_SP8LNOuvvV-_OaXhhiSJ_fuLLzR5go0xQKphMLp8alUthiXrEFv-EECoxUVoKd0Ldw8KSxI-fJ9NCxu9vHcH8aPahucbq3T2PeWtPM8AatELW2M6CdNZpZd8Fdc8qChX7Qd3UbZuaeLT3sU6k3o9Bq3wgb15vPqXI58PoMKeUr5XTzee2iW1rbquh_CRgFjH_32trCic-rtgoYz1wiCRjXQBRZMtYmYNyrXHKkkD5y3ktbuEhsDf2_Ki8BsrLPiSThf1l4y6V1xdF2hhhDNVZo9VkxxG-E9lN1h4OvAAAA__-dC4OJ) on the operational hold. Netanyahu's Washington visit this week could determine whether the fragile pause holds. ★★★
ICE Targets Haitians Losing Status
Immigration and Customs Enforcement is preparing a [major operation](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDuSrDAMRVcDmSm3-BgCBy8h65dOSKltQWsKf8o2MMufopcwmRTcc2-dr-fyRN7Zb__RkTYnLzbYhRP6CxP5QilbjntwWNhEXEDCIKQSoBY0hU9aOqytNnZooSb9UGP_mIaul_Vbq2FdybbGKjLdC1SPcpKyHWEEUKqbatY3TipQ0PbdQzb9StSSsqOapHwRVp08osVCuTHBZ0on3p3sfbiv4BsTXL3rdykxV-2_CuYK5uu6mjX8eLrumKtgPnIFMxsSMVHERFk4_A5JhEjpwxEF00aF_SbeyIXRZ7GHfP8lZoFroSTyERM5EiYcqYh03NrqpG28eN85D6rq5OaQ98-q8lebp4bfAAAA___ZSosq) to locate and arrest Haitian nationals whose Temporary Protected Status is expiring, with the expanded push expected to begin as soon as this week. The Supreme Court's certified judgment clearing the administration to end TPS for more than 300,000 Haitians was set to reach the lower courts Monday. Federal sources say the agency will [expedite deportations](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL3unDAQxJ_GdCBjwOYKF2no_mlToj17D1bCH7L3IPf2EfcI6Uaj0W9G8-dn_QE6KG6_IaB1J60--ZUKxAsKRsZSPeUjBWByGVYllW6laZVZwTGduI7QeOu8HlSDtjfz1D_0OMlmt5N8zE4-UTs3yB4Hp81LOjMrfHqnprkhe-OkUUYN09jLbnohDmj8bB5SPhHEKN_ZA2PtXIoVywl3J8WYbpVi51JoDrsz5yqGX0ItQi3XdXUX1J3ixiniXwgUsdxRoZacDnIfoRYKgbbypQi1jFoPxoy377DdgZhajzkVbhlDTgXKp80lMTpG31YGflehlqZYny86DqraiFFuAej4ruL_ffO06l8AAAD__3Q9iZs), with Springfield, Ohio, among the locations under focus. DHS moved to end TPS for over 500,000 Haitians last summer, but the matter stayed tied up in litigation until last month's high-court ruling removed the final obstacle. ★★★
Appeals Court Blocks Ballot Order
A federal appeals court dealt the administration an election-year setback, [refusing to lift](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2y2yAQhZ9G6tAghIVvQZHG3U2bUrOwi70Z_gawlcfPKI-Q7jTfOd-cX9_HN3Dk_PwJiaz_8IEFD26QT2iUB7WOXGNJMNhXOJRUu5BGKHOAH_yhQ8OM1uO-qZnsau639WvXNzm_rFvvISi3b7Ch0xqcX53T-4o7hkAeZrZXnTTKqO2mV7ncAtFGBu_mS0pHMGn5rgiD-uJL7tQ-cG1yzuVKJS--pDna1xi1T9uPST0m9TjPcwnlT6bzwtKkHrVEHuz7pB6BkBpEAbUSxC58ebchGv0mP7oY7Z2qcIyCcijNk0jAUTiIsQxRGlIT8CJAkRgHtSQokr9M-gKpzs1iPTlG7ruZtHxe9D_H8b_ffqz6GwAA__9ie5GU) an injunction against key parts of Trump's executive order tightening mail-in voting rules across 23 Democratic-led states. The First Circuit left in place a lower-court finding that the order likely [exceeded presidential authority](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGupSAURb8GO27woOAtKKaxe9NOac6FM3oSBQKo8_kT3ye8bhcre-3sP1_LF_LOcf2NBzl_8RJSWLhgvLFQbFRq4LynAxv7jAsoMFJZCXZB3_iiZcAuOB-Mho5cb6exf5thVN3m3h-j-tCDGsBqUCOFj1d2wp48au-njt1TpyxY0OPQq9f4l0iTDZN9K_UhFIM6c8BG9eVTrFQufJwcY3pSii-fjm53W2u5Cv1LwCxgvu_7dWPdOK4tRfqHB0cqDypgjnTXh9m4kdzSWUnAPBijjTYC5lbOI0sMB0eurXxL5IG8S47ySo3jKjFnwr1Kn87SBMxdcSHfvO9cjRWDWh_-e1n76aOXg_8BAAD__zFCiqE), rejecting DOJ arguments that the challenging states lacked standing. The blocked directive would have required the Postal Service to [screen ballots](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2y6yAMhJ8Gd3gw_sEpKG7jLrc9pUcBJVEGAwPYvP4Z8ginW42k3W_2577fgRz51384UJuLdhvsTgl8hYS-YMqWogsHFDIRdinkwoXiUu1gCl24T9BZbewyyg71oNZ5uC3TLLq3Vk9hYVwnMMtoV2VXtSqL42ClGqzEpSPd7ISSSo7zNIh-fiKO2C5vQjwQ2CTOaKFg7k3wGdMFLZO8D00F35twdE6_S4mZjf-Y3Jjcaq19hfwm_yrBFzq-7weTm8eamdxaKpPb53RtaBJiRHCZm3CmwhN-0JTMSzqPyB9keQy5gOONgAzybBKi5weQ4w9wLpRm2yVtYyXnKC-KTeLV9l_C8tdmLy1_AwAA__9O-o0N) against DHS citizenship lists and refuse delivery to voters not on the approved rolls. The White House is expected to carry the fight to the Supreme Court.
